collectibles.name: The Sad Onion
collectibles.description: +0.7 Tears Up

collectibles.name: The Inner Eye
collectibles.description: Tears now shoot three at a time (Triple Shot). Tears Down significantly - Tears fired per second * 0.51

collectibles.name: Spoon Bender
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac's tears a homing effect

collectibles.name: Cricket's Head
collectibles.description: +0.5 Damage Up. x1.5 times Damage Multiplier (Does not stack with the Magic Mushroom multiplier). Can be found in golden chests. Cricket's Head used to be known as Max's Head in the original game and was renamed for Rebirth

collectibles.name: My Reflection
collectibles.description: Gives tears a boomerang effect. +1.5 Damage Up. +0.6 Shot Speed Up. -1 Luck Down. Range Up (1.6x + 1.5)

collectibles.name: Number One
collectibles.description: Gives you a very high tear rate in exchange for a big range down. +1.5 Tears Up. -2.5 Range Down

collectibles.name: Blood of the Martyr
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. x1.5 times Damage Multiplier if you also have Book of Belial (Does not stack with Magic Mushroom or Cricket's Head multipliers)

collectibles.name: Brother Bobby
collectibles.description: A familiar which follows Isaac and shoots normal tears which do 3.5 damage. Counts as 1 of 3 familiar items needed towards the Conjoined transformation

collectibles.name: Skatole
collectibles.description: A lot of fly enemies are no longer aggressive towards Isaac. Attack Fly, Dart Fly, Eternal Fly, and Ring Fly are transformed into a neutral black fly. Boom Fly, Red Boom Fly, Drowned Boom Fly move slower, but still deal contact damage.

collectibles.name: Halo of Flies
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac 2 orbital flies which block enemy shots. Picking up this item as well as 2 other fly-type items will allow you to transform into Lord of the Flies. Counts as 1 of 3 fly items needed towards the Beelzebub transformation

collectibles.name: 1up!
collectibles.description: Gives the player an extra life. When revived, the green mushroom that follows Isaac will disappear and he will respawn with the same amount of red heart containers at full health. Resurrection takes place before all other items which give you an extra life

collectibles.name: Magic Mushroom
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +0.3 Damage Up. x1.5 times Damage Multiplier (Does not stack with the multipliers from Cricket's Head / Blood of The Martyr + Book of Belial). +1.5 Range Up. +0.3 Speed Up. Increases the size of your player sprite, but doesn't increase the hitbox.

collectibles.name: The Virus
collectibles.description: Enemies touching you take 12 damage, then a poison effect is applied for 6-7 ticks, dealing damage equal to the amount of red hearts you have (up to 30.8 at 12 full red hearts). +0.2 Speed Up. Has a chance to drop from the Lust miniboss fight.

collectibles.name: Roid Rage
collectibles.description: +0.3 Speed Up. +1.5 Range Up. +0.5 Shot Height. Counts as 1 of 3 syringe items needed towards the Spun transformation
+1 HP Up. Fully restores all red heart containers. Has a chance to drop from the Gluttony miniboss fight

collectibles.name: Raw Liver
collectibles.description: +2 Health Up. Full red heart heal

collectibles.name: Skeleton Key
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac 99 Keys

collectibles.name: A Dollar
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac 100 coins. Can drop from an exploding slot machine while playing it

collectibles.name: Boom!
collectibles.description: +10 Bombs

collectibles.name: Transcendence
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac the ability to fly

collectibles.name: The Compass
collectibles.description: Shows most icons on the map (Shops, Item Rooms, Boss Rooms etc.). Does not show the layout of the map. Doesn't show the location of Secret or Super Secret rooms. Room icons will not show if a Curse of the Lost is in effect on the current floor

collectibles.name: Lunch
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up

collectibles.name: Dinner
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up

collectibles.name: Dessert
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up

collectibles.name: Breakfast
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up

collectibles.name: Rotten Meat
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up

collectibles.name: Wooden Spoon
collectibles.description: +0.3 Speed Up

collectibles.name: The Belt
collectibles.description: +0.3 Speed Up

collectibles.name: Mom's Underwear
collectibles.description: +1.5 Range Up. Gives 3-6 blue attack flies when picked up. Counts as 1 of 3 mom items needed towards the Mom transformation

collectibles.name: Mom's Heels
collectibles.description: +1.5 Range Up. Makes Isaac deal 12 contact damage per tick (24 damage per second). Counts as 1 of 3 mom items needed towards the Mom transformation

collectibles.name: Mom's Lipstick
collectibles.description: +2.25 Range Up. Drops a random heart on the floor when picked up. Counts as 1 of 3 mom items needed towards the Mom transformation

collectibles.name: Wire Coat Hanger
collectibles.description: +0.7 Tears Up

collectibles.name: The Bible
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac angel wings for the current room, allowing him to fly. Instantly kills the Mom's Foot, Mom's Heart and It Lives boss fights. If used during the Satan fight, The Bible will instantly kill Isaac.

collectibles.name: The Book of Belial
collectibles.description: Upon use, gives +2 damage up which lasts for the current room. x1.5 times Damage Multiplier if you also have Blood of the Martyr (Does not stack with Magic Mushroom or Cricket's Head multipliers).

collectibles.name: The Necronomicon
collectibles.description: Deals 40 damage to everything in the room when used. Counts as 1 of 3 book items needed towards the Bookworm transformation

collectibles.name: The Poop
collectibles.description: Drops a poop on the floor. Blue Baby starts with this item. Can be placed next to a pit and exploded to make a bridge. Can be placed over a broken red poop to overwrite it, causing it to no longer regenerate.

collectibles.name: Mr. Boom
collectibles.description: Drops a large bomb below the player which does 185 damage. Compatible with bomb modifiers, such as Glitter Bombs, Sticky Bombs etc. Has a chance to drop from the Wrath miniboss fight

collectibles.name: Tammy's Head
collectibles.description: Fires 10 tears in a circle around Isaac. Each tear is equal to your damage stat + 25 flat damage. The tears spawned from Tammy's Head retain tear effects of Isaac's tears, such as poison or homing

collectibles.name: Mom's Bra
collectibles.description: When used, freezes all enemies in the current room for about 4 seconds. Counts as 1 of 3 mom items needed towards the Mom transformation

collectibles.name: Kamikaze!
collectibles.description: Causes an explosion near Isaac which takes away half a heart and does 40 damage all enemies in close proximity. Does not reduce your devil/angel room chances when used

collectibles.name: Mom's Pad
collectibles.description: When used, causes all enemies in the current room to run away from Isaac in fear for 5 seconds. Spawns 1 blue attack fly per use. Counts as 1 of 3 mom items needed towards the Mom transformation

collectibles.name: Bob's Rotten Head
collectibles.description: A poison bomb which can be thrown and leaves a poison effect on any enemies within the blast radius. It also leaves a gas cloud at the place where it exploded.

collectibles.name: Teleport!
collectibles.description: Teleports Isaac to a random location on the map. Can't be used to teleport to the I AM ERROR room

collectibles.name: Yum Heart
collectibles.description: Heals Isaac for one whole red heart. Maggy starts with this item. When used as the Keeper, one coin HP is restored. Has a chance to drop from the Super Lust miniboss fight

collectibles.name: Lucky Foot
collectibles.description: +1.0 Luck Up. Better chance to win while gambling at the Shell Game and Fortune Telling Machine. Higher chance to get a random drop after clearing a room. Converts all negative pills into their positive counterparts.

collectibles.name: Doctor's Remote
collectibles.description: A target is placed on the floor which can be controlled. After a few seconds a huge missile hits the target and deals 20x your tear damage to anything nearby. Essentially a one-time use of the Epic Fetus item

collectibles.name: Cupid's Arrow
collectibles.description: Isaac's tears now have a piercing effect which allows them to travel through enemies instead of breaking on hit

collectibles.name: Shoop da Whoop!
collectibles.description: When used, fires a high damage laser in a straight line across the room in a similar way to Brimstone. The laser deals damage equal to double your tear damage. The laser hits up to 13 times if an enemy stays inside it for the duration.

collectibles.name: Steven
collectibles.description: +1 Damage Up. Can only be dropped by the Steven boss

collectibles.name: Pentagram
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. +10% chance of a devil/angel room opening while held. A second Pentagram will give an extra +5% chance. Counts as 1 of 3 evil items needed towards the Leviathan transformation

collectibles.name: Dr. Fetus
collectibles.description: Instead of tears, Isaac now shoots bombs from his eyes, which explode dealing damage to anything nearby. Bomb damage = damage * 10. Tears Down (Tear delay * 2.5). Bombs will also synergize with other bomb items and tear modifiers, including Sad Bombs, Mr.

collectibles.name: Magneto
collectibles.description: Causes pickups on the floor move towards the player. Works across pits, but not through Key blocks. Chests up to 2 tiles away from Isaac open automatically. Spiked chests are opened without damaging Isaac.

collectibles.name: Treasure Map
collectibles.description: Reveals the entire map for every floor except the secret room locations. Does not show the icons for any unexplored rooms.

collectibles.name: Mom's Eye
collectibles.description: Isaac has a random chance to fire another tear out the back of his head. The chance to fire the second tear can improve based on your luck stat and will always activate at +5 Luck. At +0 luck theres a ~50% chance for this effect to activate.
collectibles.quote: Eye in the back of your head

collectibles.name: Lemon Mishap
collectibles.description: When used, drops a pool of 'lemonade' on the floor which damages any enemies that come into contact with it for 8 damage per tick

collectibles.name: Distant Admiration
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac an orbiting fly which deals 5 contact damage to enemies per tick. Counts as 1 of 3 fly items needed towards the Beelzebub transformation

collectibles.name: Book of Shadows
collectibles.description: Gives the player an invulnerability effect which lasts for a 10 seconds. Can be used to get free hits on the Blood Donation machines and Devil Beggars. Counts as 1 of 3 book items needed towards the Bookworm transformation

collectibles.name: The Book of Belial
collectibles.description: Receive for 60 seconds:. +2 Health. +1.5 Fire rate. -0.1 Speed

collectibles.name: The Ladder
collectibles.description: Allows Isaac to walk over gaps with a width of one tile

collectibles.name: Charm of the Vampire
collectibles.description: +0.3 Damage Up. Heals half a heart after every 13 enemies killed. Works with the Keeper for restoring coin HP

collectibles.name: The Battery
collectibles.description: All spacebar items can now be 'overcharged', allowing them to be charged up twice instead of once. The extra charges appear in yellow on top of the normal green bars. This item works with self-recharging items

collectibles.name: Steam Sale
collectibles.description: Items in the shop are now -50% off. 15c items are reduced to 7c. 5c pickups become 3c. 3c pickups become 2c. Taking more than 1 steam sale reduces the price of all items even further.

collectibles.name: Anarchist Cookbook
collectibles.description: Spawns 6 troll bombs at random locations around the room. Bombs are effected by other passive bomb items. Has a chance to drop from the Pride miniboss fight. Counts as 1 of 3 book items needed towards the Bookworm transformation

collectibles.name: The Hourglass
collectibles.description: When used, slows down all enemies in the current room and their projectiles for about 8 seconds

collectibles.name: Sister Maggy
collectibles.description: A familiar which follows Isaac around and shoots blood tears that deal 5 damage. The tears appear red but have no additional damage. Sister Maggy fires tears at a rate of 1 tear per second.

collectibles.name: Technology
collectibles.description: Isaac's tears are replaced with a laser that has unlimited range and can only fire at right angles. Lasers travel through enemies but not obstacles in the room.

collectibles.name: Chocolate Milk
collectibles.description: Isaac can now charge shots for more damage by holding down the fire button. At full charge, your tears do 4 times more damage. Tears fired at the minimum possible charge do roughly 1/3 of your normal damage.

collectibles.name: Growth Hormones
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. +0.2 Speed Up. Counts as 1 of 3 syringe items needed towards the Spun transformation

collectibles.name: Mini Mush
collectibles.description: +0.3 Speed Up. +1.5 Range Up. Causes Isaac to shrink in size (including hitbox slightly). Can be dropped when exploding mushrooms in the environment that are usually found in the Caves/Catacombs and in secret rooms.

collectibles.name: Rosary
collectibles.description: +3 Soul Hearts. +0.5 Tears Up. Adds several instances of The Bible item into all item pools. Counts as 1 of 3 angel items needed towards the Seraphim transformation

collectibles.name: Cube of Meat
collectibles.description: An orbital which blocks shots and damages enemies it comes into contact with for 7 damage per tick. Exclusively drops from one of the horsemen bosses. 2 cubes of meat transform the orbital into a meat head which fires blood tears which deal 3.5 damage each.

collectibles.name: A Quarter
collectibles.description: +25 Coins. Has a very small chance to drop after destroying one of the pots that appear in the Basement and Cellar floors. Has a chance to drop from the Super Greed miniboss fight

collectibles.name: PHD
collectibles.description: Converts most negative pills into their positive counterparts, e.g. Stat Down becomes Stat Up. Bad Trip becomes Balls of Steel. Amnesia becomes I Can See Forever etc. Pills are identified before using them. Drops one pill on pickup.

collectibles.name: X-Ray Vision
collectibles.description: Reveals the entrance to secret rooms and automatically opens the hole, removing the need for bombs to enter

collectibles.name: My Little Unicorn
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac invincibility and +0.28 Speed for 6 seconds. While active you cannot fire tears, but running into enemies will deal 40 contact damage per second. Allows free hits on the Blood Donation machines and devil beggars

collectibles.name: Book of Revelations
collectibles.description: Upon use, gives Isaac an extra Soul heart. Using this item gives you a higher chance of finding a horsemen boss at the end of the floor. +17.5% chance of a Devil Deal opening after the boss fight.

collectibles.name: The Mark
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. +0.2 Speed Up. +1 Soul Heart. Counts as 1 of 3 evil items needed towards the Leviathan transformation

collectibles.name: The Pact
collectibles.description: +0.5 Damage Up. +0.7 Tears Up. +2 Black Hearts. Counts as 1 of 3 evil items needed towards the Leviathan transformation

collectibles.name: Dead Cat
collectibles.description: Isaac's health is set to 1 and he also gains 9 extra lives. Each time Isaac dies, he will respawn with 1 Health. Has a chance to drop from the Super Pride mini boss.

collectibles.name: Lord of the Pit
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac demon wings and the ability to fly. +0.3 Speed Up. Counts as 1 of 3 evil items needed towards the Leviathan transformation.

collectibles.name: The Nail
collectibles.description: Each use of this item gives +0.7 Damage Up, -0.18 Speed Down and the ability to destroy most obstacles for the current room.. Each use also gives half a black heart, however this is stays between rooms unlike the other effects.

collectibles.name: We Need To Go Deeper!
collectibles.description: Spawns a trapdoor at Isaac's feet which allows him to travel to the next floor. Digging in certain spots with objects or markings on the floor will guarantee a crawlspace once per floor.

collectibles.name: Deck of Cards
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac a random tarot card on use. Counts as 1 of 3 astrology items needed in the same run to unlock Planetariums

collectibles.name: Monstro's Tooth
collectibles.description: When used, spawns a Monstro which will jump on a random enemy in the room, dealing 120 damage and destroying nearby obstacles

collectibles.name: Loki's Horns
collectibles.description: Everytime you fire a tear, there is a chance that you will also fire three more tears in all cardinal directions. The chance to fire 4-way tears is affected by your luck stat and at +15 Luck it will activate every time.

collectibles.name: Little Chubby
collectibles.description: A familiar that follows Isaac and charges forwards, dealing 3.5 damage per tick to any enemies it comes into contact with

collectibles.name: Spider Bite
collectibles.description: Tears now have a chance of slowing enemies and their projectiles for 2.5 seconds. The chance to slow enemies is affected by your luck stat and at +15 Luck it will activate every time

collectibles.name: The Small Rock
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. +0.2 Tears Up. -0.2 Speed Down. Has a chance to drop when exploding a tinted rock

collectibles.name: Spelunker Hat
collectibles.description: Reveals adjacent rooms up to 2 rooms away, this includes revealing if you're next to a Secret Room or Super Secret Rooms. Gives Isaac a slight glow when Curse of Darkness is active. Blocks damage from projectiles falling from above

collectibles.name: Super Bandage
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +2 Soul Hearts. Heals one red heart container when picked up

collectibles.name: The Gamekid
collectibles.description: When used Isaac transforms into pacman, which makes him invincible for 6 seconds and does 40 contact damage to enemies per chomp. Everytime you 'eat' 2 enemies, you regain 1/2 heart of red health. You can't shoot tears while the effect is active

collectibles.name: Sack of Pennies
collectibles.description: A bag that floats around following Isaac and drops a random coin every 2 rooms

collectibles.name: Robo-Baby
collectibles.description: A familiar which follows Isaac and shoots lasers, similar to the Technology item. Robo-Baby's laser is spectral and piercing (It will pass through rocks and objects in the environment). Robo-Baby's lasers deal 3.5 damage per hit.

collectibles.name: Little C.H.A.D.
collectibles.description: A familiar which follows Isaac and drops half a red heart every 3 rooms

collectibles.name: The Book of Sin
collectibles.description: Spawns a random pickup on the floor. Any pickups are possible from this item, including Bombs, hearts, keys, coins, pills, batteries, tarot cards, runes etc. Doesn't produce microbatteries, only regular sized ones and rarely golden/mega batteries.

collectibles.name: The Relic
collectibles.description: A blue cross that follows Isaac and drops a soul heart every 7 or 8 rooms

collectibles.name: Little Gish
collectibles.description: A familiar that follows Isaac and fires black tar tears, which slow enemy movement and projectile speed for a few seconds. Little Gish's tears do 3.5 damage. Little Gish fires tears at a rate of 1 tear per second. A Guaranteed drop from the Gish boss fight

collectibles.name: Little Steven
collectibles.description: A familiar that follows Isaac and fires homing tears that deal 3.5 damage each. Has a high chance to drop from the Steven boss fight. Little Steven fires tears at a rate of 1 tear per second with a slightly longer range than other familiars.

collectibles.name: The Halo
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +0.3 Damage Up. +0.2 Tears Up. +0.38 Range Up. +0.3 Speed Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up. Counts as 1 of 3 angel items needed towards the Seraphim transformation

collectibles.name: Mom's Bottle of Pills
collectibles.description: When used, gives Isaac a random pill. Counts as 1 of 3 mom items needed towards the Mom transformation

collectibles.name: The Common Cold
collectibles.description: Tears now have a random chance to apply a poison effect, causing double your tear damage per tick to enemies over time. The chance to fire poison shots is affected by your luck stat and at +12 Luck it will activate every time

collectibles.name: The Parasite
collectibles.description: Isaac's tears now split into two upon contact with enemies or the environment. Tears that split off from the main tear do less damage (tear damage * 0.5). Tears can keep splitting if they still have range and damage above 1

collectibles.name: The D6
collectibles.description: When used, replaces all pedestal items in the current room with another random item. Re-rolled items pick from the current room's item pool. Isaac starts with this item after it is unlocked

collectibles.name: Mr. Mega
collectibles.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs now do 185 damage (up from 100) and have a larger blast radius. Can be found in the secret room. Has a chance to drop from the Super Wrath miniboss fight

collectibles.name: The Pinking Shears
collectibles.description: Cuts Isaac's head from his body for the current room, allowing him to fly and leaving the decapitated body to run around attacking enemies for 5.5 damage per tick

collectibles.name: The Wafer
collectibles.description: All damage taken is reduced to half a heart. Damaged reduction is reduced from every source in the game except Devil Deals and health down pills. Does not prevent death (i.e. Suicide King or using The Bible on Isaac, ??? or Satan).

collectibles.name: Money = Power
collectibles.description: +0.04 Damage Up for every coin you currently have. At 99 coins this item gives +3.96 Damage Up. +0.04 per coin is the amount added before the damage formula is calculated, as this is the only way to show a consistent amount of damage given.

collectibles.name: Mom's Contacts
collectibles.description: Tears now have a random chance to freeze enemies in place. The chance to freeze enemies is affected by your luck stat. +0.38 Range Up. Chance to activate increases with luck, up to around 50% chance at +20 luck.

collectibles.name: The Bean
collectibles.description: Upon use, this item causes Isaac to fart and poison any enemies in close proximity. The Bean deals 5 damage, then poisons enemies for 6 total ticks of damage. The poison deals your current tear damage per tick

collectibles.name: Guardian Angel
collectibles.description: An orbital which does 7 contact damage per tick, blocks shots and increases the speed of all other orbitals. Counts as 1 of 3 angel items needed towards the Seraphim transformation. Counts as 1 of 3 familiar items needed towards the Conjoined transformation.

collectibles.name: Demon Baby
collectibles.description: A familiar which follows Isaac and automatically fires tears that deal 3 damage each at any enemies in close range. Counts as 1 of 3 familiar items needed towards the Conjoined transformation.

collectibles.name: Mom's Knife
collectibles.description: Tears are replaced with a knife which can be charged and thrown in a boomerang style action. The knife can also do damage without being thrown as a close range melee weapon. When used as a melee weapon, Mom's Knife deals your tear damage * 2 per tick.

collectibles.name: Ouija Board
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac spectral tears which allows them to travel through objects in the environment (i.e. rocks). +0.4 Tears Up

collectibles.name: 9 Volt
collectibles.description: Automatically gives you 1 bar of charge after using your spacebar item. Fully recharges your current spacebar item when picked up. Any items which are normally a 1 room recharge are now timed instead

collectibles.name: Dead Bird
collectibles.description: When Isaac takes damage, the dead bird will spawn and attack nearby enemies in the current room for 2 damage per tick. Eve starts with this item

collectibles.name: Brimstone
collectibles.description: Tears are replaced with the ability to charge and fire a powerful laser that travels in a straight line across the room, dealing a lot of damage (tear damage hits for 9 ticks per laser) to any enemies it comes into contact with.

collectibles.name: Blood Bag
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +0.3 Speed Up. Heals for 5 full red hearts. Has a chance to drop while playing any Blood Donation machine

collectibles.name: Odd Mushroom (Thin)
collectibles.description: Gives you a high rate of fire in exchange for a damage down. +1.7 Tears Up. +0.3 Speed Up. Damage Down (damage * 0.9 - 0.4). Counts as 1 of 3 mushroom items needed towards the Fun Guy transformation

collectibles.name: Odd Mushroom (Large)
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +1.0 Damage Up. +0.38 Range Up. -0.2 Speed Down. Heals one red heart container when picked up. Counts as 1 of 3 mushroom items needed towards the Fun Guy transformation

collectibles.name: Whore of Babylon
collectibles.description: When you only have half a red heart remaining or less, you enter a curse state which adds +1.5 damage and +0.3 speed.

collectibles.name: Monster Manual
collectibles.description: When used, gives a random familiar for the entire floor. It can spawn familiars you haven't unlocked yet!

collectibles.name: Dead Sea Scrolls
collectibles.description: Upon use, the dead sea scrolls gives a random active item effect. An item that can be found in the Angel room. The name of the effect given is displayed when used.. Cannot give the Kamikaze effect

collectibles.name: Bobby-Bomb
collectibles.description: +5 Bombs. All of Isaac's bombs now having a homing effect when placed on the floor

collectibles.name: Razor Blade
collectibles.description: When used, deals damage to Isaac in exchange for +1.2 damage up which lasts for the current room. This item takes 1 full heart of damage per use, and will take red hearts first before any other.

collectibles.name: Forget Me Now
collectibles.description: Upon use, this item refreshes the current floor with brand new rooms, monsters and items, as if you had entered a new floor

collectibles.name: Forever Alone
collectibles.description: An orbiting fly which deals 2 contact damage per tick to enemies. Counts as 1 of 3 fly items needed towards the Beelzebub transformation

collectibles.name: Bucket of Lard
collectibles.description: +2 Health Up. -0.2 Speed Down. Has a chance to drop from the Super Gluttony miniboss fight

collectibles.name: A Pony
collectibles.description: Allows Isaac to fly while the Pony is held. Sets your speed stat to 1.5 if it isn't already that high. When the active attack is used, Isaac will dash across the screen dealing scaling contact damage to anything he hits (damage * 4 + 28).

collectibles.name: Bomb Bag
collectibles.description: A bag of bombs that will drop a bomb pickup every 2 rooms

collectibles.name: A Lump of Coal
collectibles.description: Tears gain a damage up and increase in size based on the distance they travel. The length of a normal room roughly gives +6 damage, but this can be higher with double rooms or Tiny Planet.

collectibles.name: Guppy's Paw
collectibles.description: When used, removes one heart container and gives you 3 soul hearts. Bone hearts cannot be converted. Counts as 1 of 3 cat items needed towards the Guppy transformation

collectibles.name: Guppy's Tail
collectibles.description: Gives a 1/3 chance for room clear rewards to become a normal or locked chest, and a 1/3 chance to reward nothing at all. Doesn't affect coins dropped after waves in Greed Mode. Counts as 1 of 3 cat items needed towards the Guppy transformation

collectibles.name: IV Bag
collectibles.description: Upon use, the IV Bag takes half a red heart and spawns 1-3 coins (the same effect as a blood donation machine). Can drop from a blood donation machine after playing it. In the Womb and beyond this deals 1 full heart of damage.

collectibles.name: Best Friend
collectibles.description: Places a decoy on the floor which attracts enemies and explodes after a period of time. When it explodes, it deals 185 damage to everything in radius (Same damage as Mr Mega bombs)

collectibles.name: Remote Detonator
collectibles.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs no longer automatically explode and will only do so when you activate the remote detonator. Can be used to detonate Dr. Fetus bombs early

collectibles.name: Stigmata
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +0.3 Damage Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up

collectibles.name: Mom's Purse
collectibles.description: Isaac can now hold two trinkets at the same time. Drops a random trinket on the floor when picked up. Allows you to pick up more trinkets while also holding The Tick. Counts as 1 of 3 mom items needed towards the Mom transformation

collectibles.name: Bob's Curse
collectibles.description: +5 Bombs. Isaac's bombs now poison nearby enemies and leave behind a gas cloud that poisons enemies that move through it. Poisoned enemies take 4 or 6 damage per tick for a few seconds. Has a chance to drop from the Super Sloth miniboss fight.

collectibles.name: Pageant Boy
collectibles.description: Spawns 7 random coins around Isaac on the floor. Isaac wears a pink crown on his head

collectibles.name: Scapular
collectibles.description: Once per room when you are damaged down to your final half a heart, you gain 1 soul heart. Re-entering a room allows this effect to be triggered again.

collectibles.name: Speed Ball
collectibles.description: +0.3 Speed Up. +0.2 Shot Speed Up. Counts as 1 of 3 syringe items needed towards the Spun transformation

collectibles.name: Bum Friend
collectibles.description: A beggar who follows Isaac around and automatically picks up nearby coins. After picking up 6 coins he will drop a random pickup, e.g. hearts, keys, bombs, coins, pills, cards, trinkets, batteries etc.

collectibles.name: Guppy's Head
collectibles.description: When used, spawns between 2-4 blue flies. Blue Flies do double your tear damage. Counts as 1 of 3 cat items needed towards the Guppy transformation

collectibles.name: Prayer Card
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac an eternal heart when used. Taking an eternal heart to the next floor or collecting two on the same floor gives you an extra heart container

collectibles.name: Notched Axe
collectibles.description: When activated, Isaac takes out the axe and gives you the ability to break rocks and damage enemies with it. It has a limited amount of uses per floor, decreasing with every hit that connects with a rock/enemy.

collectibles.name: Infestation
collectibles.description: When Isaac gets hit, 2-6 blue flies will randomly spawn. Blue Flies do double your tear damage. Counts as 1 of 3 fly items needed towards the Beelzebub transformation

collectibles.name: Ipecac
collectibles.description: Isaac's tears are replaced with explosive poison bombs, which will arc upwards and explode on contact with the floor, dealing huge damage and leaving a poison effect on enemies in range.

collectibles.name: Tough Love
collectibles.description: Isaac has a random chance to fire a tooth shot instead of a tear sometimes. Teeth shots deal damage equal to your tear damage * 3.2. The chance to fire a tooth is affected by your luck stat and at +9 Luck it will activate every time.

collectibles.name: The Mulligan
collectibles.description: Isaac has a 1/6 chance to spawn a blue fly when one of his tears hits an enemy. Blue Flies do double your tear damage. The chance to activate this effect is not changed with your Luck stat. Counts as 1 of 3 fly items needed towards the Beelzebub transformation

collectibles.name: Technology 2
collectibles.description: Isaac now also has a laser with unlimited range which fires continuously, dealing damage 15 times per second. Tears continue to fire from your left eye at a rate of 2/3. The laser deals damage equal to 1/7th of your tear damage, but very rapidly.

collectibles.name: Mutant Spider
collectibles.description: Tears now shoot 4 at a time (Quad Shot). Tears Down significantly (Tear delay * 2.1 + 3). Synergizes well with a lot of tear effects - e.g. with Brimstone you get 4 lasers. Counts as 1 of 3 spider items needed towards the Spider Baby transformation

collectibles.name: Chemical Peel
collectibles.description: +2 Damage Up for tears fired from Isaac's left eye. If playing as Cain or you have an item which modifies which eye you fire tears from, each shot has a 50% chance to do +2 Damage

collectibles.name: The Peeper
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac an eye companion that floats around the room and deals 8 damage per tick on contact with enemies. Damage from Isaac's left eye deal roughly +35% damage

collectibles.name: Habit
collectibles.description: When you take damage, this item recharges one room's worth of charge to your spacebar item. For example, with the D6 you would need to take damage 6 times to fully recharge it

collectibles.name: Bloody Lust
collectibles.description: Each time you take damage, you gain a damage up which lasts for the rest of the floor and turn a darker red colour each time. After taking 6 hits Bloody Lust doesn't give you any further damage increases.

collectibles.name: Crystal Ball
collectibles.description: Upon use, reveals the map and drops either a soul heart or a random card/rune (50% chance for each). It reveals the location of the secret room, however it doesn't reveal the Super secret room. Has a chance to drop from playing a fortune machine.

collectibles.name: Spirit of the Night
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac the ability to fly and spectral tears. Counts as 1 of 3 evil items needed towards the Leviathan transformation

collectibles.name: Crack the Sky
collectibles.description: Creates 5 beams of light from the sky that deal damage equal to your tear damage + 20 to any enemies which come into contact with them. The beams have a high chance to spawn on top of enemies where possible

collectibles.name: Ankh
collectibles.description: Upon death, you respawn in the previous room as Blue Baby with three Soul hearts. This is a one time use item and all new heart containers will be soul hearts. Can be used to unlock some of Blue Baby's secrets before having the character available

collectibles.name: Celtic Cross
collectibles.description: Upon taking damage, you have a 20% chance to gain an invulnerability shield for 7 seconds. The chance to gain a shield is affected by your luck stat and at +27 Luck it will activate every time.

collectibles.name: Ghost Baby
collectibles.description: A familiar which follows Isaac and shoots spectral tears that deal 3.5 damage. Ghost Baby fires tears at a rate of 1 tear per second. Can drop while destroying skulls in the Depths and Necropolis floors.

collectibles.name: The Candle
collectibles.description: A spacebar item which allows Isaac to fire a blue flame that damages anything in its path for 23 damage per tick. Can cause up to a total of 276 potential damage. The flame destroys enemy shots, making it useful for bullet hell bosses

collectibles.name: Cat-o-nine-tails
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. +0.23 Shot Speed Up. An item only found in the Boss room pool

collectibles.name: D20
collectibles.description: Upon use, re-rolls all pickup consumables in the current room into another random kind of pickup. This includes all types of pickup such as hearts, bombs, keys, coins, pills, tarot cards, chests, trinkets etc

collectibles.name: Harlequin Baby
collectibles.description: A familiar which follows Isaac and shoots two normal tears at once in a V-shaped pattern. Each of Harlequin Baby's tears deal 4 damage. Harlequin Baby fires tears at a rate of 1 tear per second.

collectibles.name: Epic Fetus
collectibles.description: Tears now become missiles which deal huge damage to anything nearby. Missiles damage = damage * 20. This item places a controllable red target on the ground which will cause a missile to fall from the sky and hit it after a short period of time

collectibles.name: Polyphemus
collectibles.description: High Damage Up - (damage + 4) * 2. Tears Down significantly (Tear delay * 2.1 + 3). If a tear kills an enemy, it continues to travel forward with the leftover damage

collectibles.name: Daddy Longlegs
collectibles.description: A shadow follows Isaac and stomps on enemies randomly, dealing 40 damage per stomp (2 damage ticks at 20 damage each). Counts as 1 of 3 spider items needed towards the Spider Baby transformation.

collectibles.name: Spider Butt
collectibles.description: Upon use, does 10 damage to all enemies in the room and gives them a slowing effect for 4 seconds. Enemies killed by Spider Butt will spawn friendly blue spiders. Counts as 1 of 3 spider items needed towards the Spider Baby transformation

collectibles.name: Sacrificial Dagger
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac an orbital knife that blocks shots and deals 15 damage per tick on contact with enemies. The highest damage orbital in the game, dealing 225 damage per second. Synergises very well with invulnerability items such as Book of Shadows

collectibles.name: Mitre
collectibles.description: Gives a 33% chance of converting red heart drops into soul hearts. Counts as 1 of 3 angel items needed towards the Seraphim transformation

collectibles.name: Rainbow Baby
collectibles.description: A familiar the follows Isaac and fires random tears. Rainbow Baby's tears can choose from any of the other familiars, such as homing, spectral, tar shots etc. Counts as 1 of 3 familiar items needed towards the Conjoined transformation.

collectibles.name: Dad's Key
collectibles.description: Upon use, opens all closed doors in the current room, including the ones which require a key to enter and secret room doors. Can be used to open the golden door that appears in the Dark Room or the Chest.

collectibles.name: Stem Cells
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +0.16 Shot Speed Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up

collectibles.name: Portable Slot
collectibles.description: Using the portable slot takes a coin and has a chance to give a pickup - similar to how the normal slot machines work

collectibles.name: Holy Water
collectibles.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots. Upon hitting an enemy, it will deal 7 damage and shatter, creating a pool of damaging blue creep that also petrifies enemies that touch it.

collectibles.name: Fate
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac an eternal heart and the ability to fly. Taking an eternal heart to the next floor or collecting two on the same floor gives you an extra heart container

collectibles.name: The Black Bean
collectibles.description: Upon taking damage, Isaac will fart, causing all enemies in close proximity to become poisoned. Black Bean deals your tear damage for 6 ticks

collectibles.name: White Pony
collectibles.description: Allows Isaac to fly while the White Pony is held. While held, sets your speed stat to 1.5 if it isn't already that high. If your speed stat is already higher then that value is still used.

collectibles.name: Sacred Heart
collectibles.description: Tears are now white, do a lot more damage and move slower across the screen with a homing effect. Health Up. Damage Up (damage * 2.3 + 1). -0.4 Tears Down. -0.25 Shot Speed Down. Full red heart heal.

collectibles.name: Tooth Picks
collectibles.description: +0.7 Tears Up. +0.16 Shot Speed Up. Does not increase your damage, simply makes your tears red

collectibles.name: Holy Grail
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. Gives Isaac the ability to fly. Heals one red heart container when picked up. Counts as 1 of 3 angel items needed towards the Seraphim transformation

collectibles.name: Dead Dove
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac the ability to fly and spectral tears. An item only found in the Angel room. Counts as 1 of 3 angel items needed towards the Seraphim transformation

collectibles.name: Blood Rights
collectibles.description: Upon use, takes away one full heart and deals 40 damage to the entire room. Shields and invincibility effects do not prevent damage when using this item.
collectibles.quote: Mass enemy damage at a cost

collectibles.name: Guppy's Hairball
collectibles.description: Follows behind Isaac and can be swung back and forth, dealing 5 contact damage per tick to anything it hits. Every time the hairball kills an enemy, it grows in size allowing it to deal more damage.

collectibles.name: Abel
collectibles.description: A familiar that mirrors the player's movements and shoots tears directly at Isaac. Abel's tears do 3.5 damage, unless playing as Cain in which case they do 5. Counts as 1 of 3 familiar items needed towards the Conjoined transformation.

collectibles.name: SMB Super Fan
collectibles.description: Isaac turns red like Meatboy. +1 HP Up. +0.3 Damage Up. +0.2 Tears Up. +1.5 Range Up. +0.2 Speed Up. Full red heart heal

collectibles.name: Pyro
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac 99 bombs

collectibles.name: 3 Dollar Bill
collectibles.description: Grants Isaac random tear effects. Can pick from a list of 39 item effects, including 8 Inch Nails, 20/20, Apple!, Ball of Tar, Continuum, Cricket's Body, Dark Matter, Dead Eye, Death's Touch, Euthanasia, Explosivo, Eye of Belial, Fire Mind, Holy Light, Iron…

collectibles.name: Telepathy for Dummies
collectibles.description: When used, Isaac gains homing shots and +3.0 Range Up for the current room. Counts as 1 of 3 book items needed towards the Bookworm transormation

collectibles.name: MEAT!
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +0.3 Damage Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up

collectibles.name: Magic 8 Ball
collectibles.description: +0.16 Shot Speed Up. Gives Isaac a random tarot card when picked up. +15% chance for Planetariums to spawn. Counts as 1 of 3 astrology items needed in the same run to unlock Planetariums

collectibles.name: Mom's Coin Purse
collectibles.description: Drops 4 random pills on the floor around Isaac. Counts as 1 of 3 mom items needed towards the Mom transformation

collectibles.name: Squeezy
collectibles.description: +2 Soul Hearts. +0.4 Tears Up

collectibles.name: Jesus Juice
collectibles.description: +0.5 Damage Up. +0.38 Range Up

collectibles.name: Box
collectibles.description: When picked up, spawns 1 red heart, 1 key, 1 bomb, 1 coin, 1 card/rune, 1 pill and 1 trinket

collectibles.name: Mom's Key
collectibles.description: +2 Keys. Doubles the yield of hearts, coins, bombs and keys that spawn from non-red chests. Counts as 1 of 3 mom items needed towards the Mom transformation

collectibles.name: Mom's Eyeshadow
collectibles.description: Tears have a random chance to charm enemies. Charmed enemies will prioritize attacking other enemies in the room, otherwise they will still attack Isaac. The chance to charm enemies is affected by your luck stat and at +27 Luck it will activate every time.

collectibles.name: Iron Bar
collectibles.description: +0.3 Damage Up. Tears now have a chance to concuss enemies, causing them to walk around dazed and confused for a short period of time. The chance to concuss enemies is affected by your luck stat and at +27 Luck it will activate every time

collectibles.name: Midas' Touch
collectibles.description: Isaac's touch now petrifies enemies, turning them to gold for a few seconds.. If an enemy is killed while it is golden, it will drop between 1-4 coins. Contact damage is also dealt to enemies equal to the amount of coins Isaac is currently holding.

collectibles.name: Humbleing Bundle
collectibles.description: All future pennies, keys, bombs and hearts have a chance to drop in pairs. Does not work for other pickups, such as soul hearts, nickels, dimes, cards, pills etc. Does not affect existing pickups that already dropped before taking this item

collectibles.name: Fanny Pack
collectibles.description: When you take damage, there is a 50% chance to drop a random heart, key, bomb or coin

collectibles.name: Sharp Plug
collectibles.description: When your spacebar item is not fully charged, you can press spacebar to recharge it at the cost half of a heart per charge. Can be used on partially charged items. Will not kill you if used - it stops a half a heart left.

collectibles.name: Guillotine
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. -1 Tear Delay (Tears Up). Causes Isaac's head to detach and orbit his body, blocking shots and dealing 7 contact damage per tick. BFFs will cause the Guillotine head to do double damage (14 damage per tick).

collectibles.name: Ball of Bandages
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac an orbital ball of bandages that deals 7 contact damage per tick and blocks enemy shots.

collectibles.name: Champion Belt
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. Increases the chance of champion enemies appearing by 15%. Doesn't affect the chance for champion bosses to spawn. An item only found in the Shop room pool

collectibles.name: Butt Bombs
collectibles.description: +5 bombs. Bombs now become poop bombs, which deal 10 damage to all enemies in the room and daze them for a short period of time. Butt Bombs heal the poop bosses (Dingle, Dangle, Brownie) by 25% of their max HP.

collectibles.name: Gnawed Leaf
collectibles.description: If Isaac stands still and stops shooting for a second, he turns to stone, making him invincible until he moves/shoots again. Using bombs or your active item will remove the invicibility as well. This item is a reference to the Tanuki suit in Super Mario 3

collectibles.name: Spiderbaby
collectibles.description: Spawns 2-5 friendly attack spiders every time you take damage. Counts as 1 of 3 spider items needed towards the Spider Baby transformation

collectibles.name: Guppy's Collar
collectibles.description: When Isaac dies, he has a 50% chance to resurrect with 1/2 a heart. Counts as 1 of 3 cat items needed towards the Guppy transformation

collectibles.name: Lost Contact
collectibles.description: All of Isaac's tears now have a shield, allowing them to block an enemy projectile. If a tear blocks something, both Isaac's and the enemies tears are destroyed. -0.16 Shot Speed Down

collectibles.name: Anemic
collectibles.description: +1.5 Range Up. When Isaac takes damage, he will start to leave a trail of blood creep behind him as he walks for the current room. The creep deals 2 damage per tick while enemies stand in it. Lazarus' revived form (Lazarus II) respawns with this item

collectibles.name: Goat Head
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac a guaranteed devil or angel room on every floor that they can appear, even if you have already beaten the boss and it didn't show up originally.

collectibles.name: Ceremonial Robes
collectibles.description: +3 Black Hearts. +1 Damage Up. When depleted, Black Hearts deal 40 damage to the entire room, in a Necronomicon style effect

collectibles.name: Mom's Wig
collectibles.description: Isaac now has a small chance to create friendly attack spiders everytime he fires a tear. Can create up to a maximum of 5 spiders in the room at one time.

collectibles.name: Placenta
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. Gives a chance to heal 1/2 a red heart every time the in-game timer hits a new minute. Heals one red heart container when picked up.

collectibles.name: Old Bandage
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. The given heart container is empty. When you get hit, you will sometimes cause hearts to drop on the floor. The chance to drop hearts is affected by your luck stat and at +29 Luck it will activate 50% of the time

collectibles.name: Sad Bombs
collectibles.description: +5 Bombs. Everytime a bomb explodes, it will release a circle of 10 tears outwards, much like the Tammy's Head effect. The tears from each bomb deal a flat 25 damage and are affected by any tear modifiers Isaac has.

collectibles.name: Rubber Cement
collectibles.description: Isaac's tears now bounce off walls and objects in the environment, such as rocks and pots. Allows tears to hit the same enemy multiple times. If you also have Lost Contact, tears will bounce off enemy projectiles instead of being destroyed

collectibles.name: Anti-Gravity
collectibles.description: -2 Tear Delay (Tears Up). As you hold down the fire button, shots will float in the same place until you release the fire key again. Allows you to store up a lot of tears in the air and release them all at once.

collectibles.name: Pyromaniac
collectibles.description: +5 Bombs. All explosions now heal Isaac for 0.5 red hearts instead of hurting him. Pyromaniac grants Isaac immunity to fire, but does not protect against stomps or shockwave effects

collectibles.name: Cricket's Body
collectibles.description: -1 Tear Delay (Tears Up). -1.3 Range Down. x1.2 Tear Size. Makes tears break into 4 smaller tears on impact with anything, which deal half of your damage

collectibles.name: Gimpy
collectibles.description: When getting hit, this item has a chance to drop a soul heart or black heart. The chance to spawn a heart is affected by your luck stat and at +22 Luck it will activate 50% of the time. Enemies have a chance to drop half a red heart when killed

collectibles.name: Black Lotus
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +1 Soul Heart. +1 Black Heart. Heals one red heart container when picked up. When depleted, Black Hearts deal 40 damage to the entire room, in a Necronomicon style effect. An item only found in the secret room pool

collectibles.name: Piggy Bank
collectibles.description: +3 Coins when picked up. When you take damage, 1-2 coins will drop on the floor. When playing as the Keeper, this item drops 0-1 coins instead

collectibles.name: Mom's Perfume
collectibles.description: -1 Tear Delay (Tears Up). Isaac's tears have a 15% chance of causing a fear effect. Feared enemies will run away from Isaac temporarily. The chance to fear enemies is affected by your luck stat and at +85 Luck it will activate every time.

collectibles.name: Monstro's Lung
collectibles.description: Tears can now be charged and released in a shotgun style effect, much like Monstro's main attack. Tears down (Tear delay * 4.3). Partial charging does nothing - must be fully charged to use

collectibles.name: Abaddon
collectibles.description: On pickup Abaddon converts all your heart containers to black hearts, then gives you +2 more black hearts. +1.5 Damage Up. +0.2 Speed Up. Tears now have a chance to induce the fear effect, causing enemies to run away from Isaac for a short period.
collectibles.quote: Evil up + DMG up + fear shot

collectibles.name: Ball of Tar
collectibles.description: Isaac leaves a trail of tar behind him which will slow down enemies that walk over it. Tears have a chance to slow enemies and their projectiles for a short period of time.

collectibles.name: Stop Watch
collectibles.description: +0.3 Speed Up. The Stop Watch applies a permanent but slight slowing effect to all enemies and their projectiles. The slowing effect has a reduced effect against Brimstone lasers fired by enemies
collectibles.quote: Let's slow this down a bit

collectibles.name: Tiny Planet
collectibles.description: Range greatly increased. Grants spectral tears. Tears now revolve around Isaac's Body at a fixed distance until they hit the ground. The tears orbit close to Isaac, offset slightly in the direction fired.

collectibles.name: Infestation 2
collectibles.description: Creates a friendly blue spider when you kill an enemy. Spiders are spawned at the location where the enemy died. Counts as 1 of 3 spider items needed towards the Spider Baby transformation.

collectibles.name: E. Coli
collectibles.description: E. Coli turns normal enemies into poop if they touch you. Enemies can turn into poop even if they do not do contact damage, allowing you to apply the effect without taking damage. Can be combined with Midas Touch to turn enemies into Golden Poop.

collectibles.name: Death's Touch
collectibles.description: +1.5 Damage Up. -0.3 Tears Down. x2 Tear Size. Isaac's tears turn into large scythes that pierce through enemies (Similar to how Death's scythes look)

collectibles.name: Key Piece 1
collectibles.description: Increases your chances to find an Angel Room instead of a Devil Room. See the dedicated Devil room page for more details. First half of the key required to enter the door to the Mega Satan boss.

collectibles.name: Key Piece 2
collectibles.description: Increases your chances to find an Angel Room instead of a Devil Room. See the dedicated Devil room page for more details. Second half of the key required to enter the door to the Mega Satan boss.

collectibles.name: Experimental Treatment
collectibles.description: Randomly increases 4 of your stats, and decreases 2 of them. Possible stat changes are fixed values: ±1 health, ±1 damage, ±0.2 speed, ±0.5 range, ±0.5 tears, ±0.2 shot speed, ±1 luck. Counts as 1 of 3 syringe items needed towards the Spun transformation
collectibles.quote: Some stats up, some stats down

collectibles.name: Contract from Below
collectibles.description: Doubles pickups and chests from clearing a room. Also gives a 30% chance for room clear rewards to not spawn. Doesn't affect coins spawned in Greed Mode

collectibles.name: Infamy
collectibles.description: Gives a 50% chance to not take damage from projectiles

collectibles.name: Trinity Shield
collectibles.description: Puts a shield in front of Isaac which blocks projectiles. The shield will rotate based on the direction in which Isaac is firing tears

collectibles.name: Tech.5
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac a laser that will fire at random intervals in addition to your normal tears. Each laser does damage equal to your current tear damage.
Isaac now shoots two tears at once. 0.75x damage multiplier. Unlike the Inner Eye and Mutant Spider items, this double shot item does not give a tears down

collectibles.name: Blue Map
collectibles.description: Reveals the locations of the secret and super secret room for the current floor and all future floors

collectibles.name: BFFS!
collectibles.description: Makes all of Isaac's familiars stronger and bigger. Causes most familiars to deal double damage. Has no effect on most familiars that scale with Isaac's tear damage

collectibles.name: Hive Mind
collectibles.description: Causes your friendly blue spiders and flies to become bigger and do x2 more damage. Allows Mom's Wig to spawn a maximum of 10 spiders at once instead of 5. Fly and spider familiars become stronger similar to BFFS.

collectibles.name: There's Options
collectibles.description: Two items now spawn after beating a boss fight and the boss rush, however only one can be taken. The additional item will pick from the Boss Item Pool. Does nothing after the Krampus fight. Unlocked by donating to the donation machine in the shop

collectibles.name: Bogo Bombs
collectibles.description: All bomb pickups are now 1+1 bombs. An item only found in the Shop item pool

collectibles.name: Starter Deck
collectibles.description: Spawns a random card. Isaac can now hold 2 cards or runes at once. Tap the drop button to cycle between each one. All future pill drops will now instead become cards. An item only available in the Shop room

collectibles.name: Little Baggy
collectibles.description: Allows for 2 pills to be held. Tap the drop button to cycle between each one. Drops a pill on the floor when picked up. Changes all card and rune drops into pills.

collectibles.name: Magic Scab
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +1.0 Luck Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up

collectibles.name: Blood Clot
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up (Left eye only). +1.5 Range Up (Left eye only). The above stats only apply to tears fired from Isaac's left eye or with a 50% chance if you have an item which causes you to fire from a single source only

collectibles.name: Screw
collectibles.description: +0.5 Tears Up. +0.2 Shot Speed Up

collectibles.name: Hot Bombs
collectibles.description: +5 Bombs. Grants immunity to fire. Enemies touching placed bombs take 16 damage. Gives all bombs a burning effect when they explode, leaving fire on the floor which deals 22 damage to enemies

collectibles.name: Fire Mind
collectibles.description: Isaac's tears now set enemies on fire, leaving a damage over time effect that does 4 or 6 damage per tick. There is a chance that tears that hit enemies will explode, leaving a small fire on the floor that damages enemies.

collectibles.name: Missing No.
collectibles.description: When picked up, and at the start of each floor this rerolls all your current items, giving you a new item to replace each of the ones you had. Also rerolls all your stats at the same time, giving a random flat modifier that changes each time.

collectibles.name: Dark Matter
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. Tears now have a chance to apply the fear effect to enemies, which causes them to run away from Isaac. The chance to fear enemies is affected by your luck stat and at +20 Luck it will activate every time.

collectibles.name: Black Candle
collectibles.description: +1 Black Heart. Immunity to all floor curses (e.g. Curse of the Lost). Black Candle removes the teleportation effect of Cursed Eye. +15% chance of a devil or angel room opening after the boss fight

collectibles.name: Proptosis
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac high damage tears with a short range. Tear size and damage falls off very fast with this item, the further the tear travels the less damage it does. Tear damage starts at triple (300%) and decreases over range to eventually be 0%

collectibles.name: Missing Page 2
collectibles.description: +1 Black Heart. If the total sum of all your health is at one heart after taking damage, the necronomicon effect will activate, dealing 40 damage to the entire room. Missing Page 2 now doubles all black heart and Necronomicon damage to 80
collectibles.quote: Evil up + your enemies will pay

collectibles.name: Clear Rune
collectibles.description: When used, copies the effect of the Rune or Soul stone you are holding (like the Blank Card). Drops a random rune on the floor when picked up. The recharge time of this item depends on the Rune/Soul Stone held:. 1 room: Soul of Lazarus.

collectibles.name: Smart Fly
collectibles.description: A yellow orbital fly that will block shots and when Isaac gets hit, will seek out the nearest enemy and attack it.

collectibles.name: Dry Baby
collectibles.description: A familiar that follows Isaac and blocks any shots that hit it. If a projectile is blocked by Dry Baby, he has a 10% chance to activate the Necronomicon effect, dealing 40 damage to the entire room.

collectibles.name: Juicy Sack
collectibles.description: A familiar that follows isaac around dropping white creep which slows down enemies that walk over it. Spawns 1-2 familiar blue spiders after every room. Blue Spiders do x2 of Isaac's damage.

collectibles.name: Robo-Baby 2.0
collectibles.description: A familiar that is controlled via the arrow keys and will automatically fire a laser if anything is in its line of sight. Robo-Baby 2.0's lasers deal 3.5 damage per hit. Counts as 1 of 3 familiar items needed towards the Conjoined transformation.
collectibles.quote: We worked out all the kinks

collectibles.name: Rotten Baby
collectibles.description: A familiar which follows Isaac and spawns a blue flies as you're firing tears. Rotten Baby can only create one fly at a time, meaning if he has created a fly he cannot make another until it is used. Blue Flies do double your tear damage.

collectibles.name: Headless Baby
collectibles.description: A familiar that follows Isaac and leaves blood creep on the floor as it floats, hurting enemies that walk over it for 2 damage per tick. Counts as 1 of 3 familiar items needed towards the Conjoined transformation

collectibles.name: Leech
collectibles.description: Spawns a familiar leech on the ground that hunts down enemies and heals you for half a heart each time it eats one. The Leech deals 1.5 contact damage per tick

collectibles.name: Mystery Sack
collectibles.description: A bag that follows Isaac and drops a random heart, coin, bomb or key every 5-6 rooms (alternating, 5 rooms then 6, then repeats). Can drop any kind of heart, coin, bomb or key

collectibles.name: BBF
collectibles.description: A large familiar black fly that bounces around the room, exploding on contact with enemies dealing 70 damage. Does not explode if it hits Isaac, however if it explodes on an enemy while Isaac is in range, he will take damage.

collectibles.name: Bob's Brain
collectibles.description: A green brain that launches in the direction you are firing your tears and will explode on contact with enemies, dealing damage and poisoning anything in the blast radius.

collectibles.name: Best Bud
collectibles.description: When Isaac takes damage, a white attack fly will spawn that orbits him at a similar distance to the Distant Admiration fly. The fly orbits a lot faster than Distant Admiration or Forever Alone and deals 10 damage per tick.

collectibles.name: Lil Brimstone
collectibles.description: A familiar that follows Isaac and can fire up and charge brimstone shots, exactly how the normal Brimstone item works but with less damage. Each laser deals 3 damage per tick, up to 8 times for a total of 24 damage. A familiar found in the devil room.

collectibles.name: Isaac's Heart
collectibles.description: Prevents Isaac from taking any damage, but instead summons a familiar heart that follows you around. If the heart is hit, Isaac will take damage. It will attempt to hide behind you when shooting. Most enemies will target the heart over Isaac himself.

collectibles.name: Lil Haunt
collectibles.description: A familiar ghost that follows Isaac around and chases enemies close-by, damaging them for 2 contact damage and causing a fear effect

collectibles.name: Dark Bum
collectibles.description: A familiar beggar similar to Bum Friend that follows Isaac and collects red hearts, giving Isaac black hearts, pills, cards, runes or spiders in return. For every 1.5 red hearts he takes, he will give a reward.
collectibles.quote: He wants to take your life

collectibles.name: Big Fan
collectibles.description: A very large orbital that moves around Isaac very slowly, blocking shots and dealing 2 contact damage per tick. Affects the speed of all other orbitals, slowing them down a lot (NOTE: This effect does not happen until you get a new orbital after Big Fan).

collectibles.name: Sissy Longlegs
collectibles.description: An adorable friendly blue spider that walks around the room laying other blue spiders which attack enemies. Blue Spiders do x2 of Isaac's damage.

collectibles.name: Punching Bag
collectibles.description: Spawns a friendly Mulligan that walks around the room. Mulligan can be hit by enemy projectiles, making him a good shield. Enemies will sometimes target the Mulligan if he is closer

collectibles.name: How to Jump
collectibles.description: When used, makes Isaac leap in the air, similar to the leaper enemies. Maintains momentum if you are already moving in the same direction. If you already have an item which gives you flying, this item becomes a dash effect instead.

collectibles.name: D100
collectibles.description: When used, the D100 will activate the effects of all other dice items at once, including D1, D4, The D6, D7, D8, D10, D12 and D20. Search 'Dice effect' to see all those items and their relevant effects.

collectibles.name: D4
collectibles.description: When used, the D4 re-rolls each item you currently have into another random item from the same item pool. If you have an item with no room pool (e.g. Blood Bag) it will be rerolled into a random Item Room item.

collectibles.name: D10
collectibles.description: When used, rerolls all enemies in the room which are currently alive into another random type of enemy. D10 attempts to reroll enemies into enemies of similar health where possible. Cannot reroll mini-bosses or bosses

collectibles.name: Blank Card
collectibles.description: When used, copies the effect of the card you are currently holding without consuming it. The charge time depends on the quality of the card you're holding, and will update with each activation.

collectibles.name: Book of Secrets
collectibles.description: When used, you have a chance of getting one of the three following effects: Treasure Map (floor layout), Compass (map icons) or Blue Map (secret room locations). Counts as 1 of 3 book items needed towards the Bookworm transformation.

collectibles.name: Box of Spiders
collectibles.description: When used, spawns 4-8 friendly blue spiders on the floor. Blue Spiders do x2 of Isaac's damage. Counts as 1 of 3 spider items needed towards the Spider Baby transformation

collectibles.name: Red Candle
collectibles.description: When used, the candle is raised above Isaac's head. Upon pressing any fire button, a red flame will slide across the floor in that direction, dealing 23 damage per tick to enemies that come into contact with it.

collectibles.name: The Jar
collectibles.description: Isaac can now pick up hearts while at full health, which will be stored in the Jar and can be spawned again using the spacebar. Up to 4 hearts can be stored in The Jar. Soul hearts and black hearts cannot be stored.

collectibles.name: Flush!
collectibles.description: When used, turns every normal enemy in the room into poop!. Does not work on mini-bosses and bosses. Kills poop bosses when used - Dingle, Dangle and Brownie. Counts as 1 of 3 poop items needed towards the Oh Crap transformation

collectibles.name: Satanic Bible
collectibles.description: When used, gives Isaac +1 Black Heart. Using this book once before the boss dies, causes the boss item on the current floor to become a devil deal instead, where it will cost heart containers to pick up.
collectibles.quote: Reusable evil... but at what cost?

collectibles.name: Head of Krampus
collectibles.description: When used, fires a 4 way brimstone laser in all cardinal directions, dealing a lot of damage to any enemies. Laser damage does not scale with your damage stat - its a fixed 10 damage per tick for 20 ticks (200 total per use).

collectibles.name: Butter Bean
collectibles.description: When used, farts on nearby enemies and knocks them backwards forcefully away from Isaac. Allows you to reflect projectiles away from Isaac. If a pushed enemy hits a rock or wall forcefully enough, they take 10 damage

collectibles.name: Magic Fingers
collectibles.description: Upon use, consumes a coin and deals damage to everything in the room. Damage dealt is equal to your tear damage * 2 + 10

collectibles.name: Converter
collectibles.description: When used, converts 1 soul/black heart into 1 red heart container. This item will take from your soul hearts first

collectibles.name: Pandora's Box
collectibles.description: When used, this item will spawn a set of items or consumables based on which chapter you are currently on. Basement 1: 2 Soul hearts. Basement 2: 2 Bombs + 2 Keys. Caves 1: 1 Boss Item. Caves 2: 1 Boss Item + 2 Soul Hearts. Depths 1: 4 Soul hearts.

collectibles.name: Unicorn Stump
collectibles.description: When used, turns Isaac invincible and gains +0.28 speed for a 5 seconds. You cannot fire tears while the stump is active. Very similar to the My Little Unicorn item but does not deal contact damage.

collectibles.name: Taurus
collectibles.description: -0.3 Speed Down. While in a hostile room your speed raises at a rate of +0.065 per game tick.

collectibles.name: Aries
collectibles.description: +0.25 Speed up. Running into enemies while at a high speed will deal 25 damage. Moving at this speed also prevents contact damage. Will not deal contact damage unless you are moving fast enough (at least 0.85 speed).

collectibles.name: Cancer
collectibles.description: +3 Soul Hearts. After getting hit once, you gain a damage reduction for the rest of the room similar to The Wafer item (-50% damage taken). Counts as 1 of 3 astrology items needed in the same run to unlock Planetariums

collectibles.name: Leo
collectibles.description: Isaac increases in size, gets a lion's mane and now has the ability to crush rocks by walking over them. Crushed rocks and poop can fill holes if you walk in their direction. Allows you to crush Red Poops and sometimes not take damage.

collectibles.name: Virgo
collectibles.description: A random chance when you take damage to get an invincibility shield for 7 seconds. The chance to get an invincibility shield is affected by your luck stat and at +10 Luck it will activate every time you get hit.

collectibles.name: Libra
collectibles.description: Gives you 6 keys, 6 bombs and 6 coins. Balances out your main stats to bring the high and low stats closer to an average value. All future stat upgrading items will now instead spread out across all other stats.

collectibles.name: Scorpio
collectibles.description: Isaac's tears turn bright green and always apply a poison effect to enemies which deals a total of double your tear damage. This is essentially a superior version of The Common Cold item.

collectibles.name: Sagittarius
collectibles.description: +0.2 Speed Up. Grants piercing tears. Tears do not travel through rocks with this item. Counts as 1 of 3 astrology items needed in the same run to unlock Planetariums

collectibles.name: Capricorn
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +0.5 Damage Up. -1 Tear Delay (Tears Up). +0.1 Speed Up. +0.75 Range Up. +1 Key, +1 Bomb, +1 Coin. Heals one red heart container when picked up. Counts as 1 of 3 astrology items needed in the same run to unlock Planetariums

collectibles.name: Aquarius
collectibles.description: Leaves a trail of tears on the floor behind Isaac which damages enemies that walk over it for 2 damage per tick. Counts as 1 of 3 astrology items needed in the same run to unlock Planetariums. Aquarius synergizes with tear effects

collectibles.name: Pisces
collectibles.description: -1 Tear Delay (Tears Up). x1.25 Tear Size Up. Tears now have a bigger knockback effect, which pushes enemies backwards. Counts as 1 of 3 astrology items needed in the same run to unlock Planetariums

collectibles.name: Eve's Mascara
collectibles.description: x2 Damage Multiplier. Tears Down by exactly half (Tear delay * 2). -0.5 Shot Speed Down. The tears down from this item is a x2.0 multiplier after the formula, meaning it will always halve your tear rate (Unless you have Monstro's Lung or Soy Milk)

collectibles.name: Judas' Shadow
collectibles.description: When you die with this item, you respawn in the previous room as Dark Judas with 2 black hearts for health. Dark Judas has a damage multiplier of 2.00 (double Isaac's damage) and an additional +0.1 Speed.

collectibles.name: Maggy's Bow
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up. All future red hearts now heal for double. Half hearts heal a whole heart and full hearts heal 2 red hearts

collectibles.name: Holy Mantle
collectibles.description: Each time you enter a new room, damage is negated for the first time you get hit. Can be used to go in and out of a Curse Room without taking damage. Counts as 1 of 3 angel items needed towards the Seraphim transformation.

collectibles.name: Thunder Thighs
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. -0.4 Speed Down. You can now break obstacles by walking over them. Heals one red heart container when picked up. Holes in the ground can be filled by crushing adjacent rocks, similar to how this can be done with bombs.
collectibles.quote: HP + speed down + you feel strong

collectibles.name: Strange Attractor
collectibles.description: Enemies and pickups (keys, bombs etc.) are now magnetically attracted to Isaac's tears. Can cause some enemies to have unpredictable movement

collectibles.name: Cursed Eye
collectibles.description: Tears are now charged up and fired rapidly in a burst of up to 5 shots at once. The amount of tears fired in the charge depends on how long you charge for.

collectibles.name: Mysterious Liquid
collectibles.description: When Isaac's tears hit anything, they leave a green toxic creep on the floor that damages enemies for 1 damage per tick

collectibles.name: Gemini
collectibles.description: A familar that is attached to Isaac, which will seek out and damage any enemies close by for 3 contact damage. Counts as 1 of 3 astrology items needed in the same run to unlock Planetariums

collectibles.name: Cain's Other Eye
collectibles.description: A familiar eye that follows Isaac and copies all his tear modifiers/effects, but shoots in random directions. Tears from this familiar deal 75% of Isaac's tear damage

collectibles.name: ???'s Only Friend
collectibles.description: A familiar fly that can be moved around via use of the arrow keys dealing 2.5 contact damage per tick, similar to the Ludovico Technique's mechanic. Counts as 1 of 3 fly items needed towards the Beelzebub transformation

collectibles.name: Samson's Chains
collectibles.description: An iron ball and chain attached to Isaac, similar to Guppy's Hairball that you can fling around to deal 5 damage per tick. The ball will block enemy shots and can also destroy environmental objects such as rocks, mushrooms and skulls.

collectibles.name: Mongo Baby
collectibles.description: A familiar that will follow Isaac and copy the effect of one of your other familiars. If you don't have any other familiars, he will just shoot normal tears. Counts as 1 of 3 familiar items needed towards the Conjoined transformation.

collectibles.name: Isaac's Tears
collectibles.description: A spacebar item that fires 8 of Isaac's tears in a circle around him. Tears spawned from this item keep most effect that Isaac currently has applied to his tears, and deal an additional +5 flat damage

collectibles.name: Undefined
collectibles.description: Upon use, teleports you to one of the following rooms at random: Item room, Secret room, Super secret room, the I AM ERROR room or the Black Market (very low chance). There are no I AM ERROR rooms on the final floors, preventing looping with this item

collectibles.name: Scissors
collectibles.description: When used will cut your head from your body. Isaac's head will remain stationary and fire tears. His body can be controlled and spews blood nearby. Tears fired by the head do a flat 3.5 damage and don't scale. REPENTANCE - Scissors has been redesigned.

collectibles.name: Breath of Life
collectibles.description: Holding the active item button will deplete the charge bar. When the charge bar gets to zero it will grant you a brief period of invincibility. If the spacebar is held for too long (about 1 second) when it has no charge, you will take damage.

collectibles.name: The Polaroid
collectibles.description: After taking damage, if you have half a red heart or less, The Polaroid will give you an invincibility shield for 5 seconds. Grants access to the Chest floor. Allows you to open the door at the beginning of Depths II that leads to the Mausoluem.

collectibles.name: The Negative
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. After taking damage, if you have half a red heart or less, The Negative will deal 40 damage to all enemies in the room. Gives you access to the Dark Room floor.

collectibles.name: The Ludovico Technique
collectibles.description: You no longer shoot tears and instead now control a single large tear with the arrow keys. Items which increase your tears stat will cause the tear to deal damage at a faster rate.

collectibles.name: Soy Milk
collectibles.description: Very high Tears Up: Tears * 5.5. -80% Damage Down. x0.5 Tear Size. REPENTANCE - Soy Milk tears now cause drastically less knockback

collectibles.name: Godhead
collectibles.description: Isaac's tears become homing and have an aura around them, which will deal a flat 2 damage per tick to anything inside its radius. +0.5 Damage Up. -0.3 Tears Down. -0.3 Shot Speed Down. Multiple GodHeads doesn't stack the aura damage.

collectibles.name: Lazarus' Rags
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac an extra life on death, exactly the same as Lazarus' default respawn effect. When you die with this item, you respawn in the same room with 1 heart and the Anemic item.

collectibles.name: The Mind
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac a full mapping effect, revealing the entire floor and locations of all secret rooms

collectibles.name: The Body
collectibles.description: +3 Health Up. The three heart containers are pre-filled with red hearts

collectibles.name: The Soul
collectibles.description: +2 Soul Hearts. Enemy projectiles will now slowly curve away from Isaac and avoid hitting him

collectibles.name: Dead Onion
collectibles.description: Isaac's tears become large, brown and will penetrate all objects and enemies (piercing + spectral). -1.2 Range Down. -0.4 Shot Speed Down. x1.5 Tear Size. Despite the increase in tear size, Dead Onion does NOT increase your damage stat.

collectibles.name: Broken Watch
collectibles.description: Upon entering every 4th unexplored room, the Broken Watch will either slow down or speed up all enemies in the room. The slow effect is much more common than the speed up. An item only found in the Shop item pool

collectibles.name: The Boomerang
collectibles.description: A blue boomerang which can be thrown in a similar fashion to Mom's Knife, to stun any enemies it hits and deal damage. The damage dealt by the Boomerang is equal to double your tear damage.

collectibles.name: Safety Pin
collectibles.description: +1.5 Range Up. +0.16 Shot Speed Up. +1 Black Heart. When depleted, Black Hearts deal 40 damage to the entire room, in a Necronomicon style effect

collectibles.name: Caffeine Pill
collectibles.description: +0.3 Speed Up. Decreases the size of Isaac, and your player hitbox, making you less likely to be hit. Gives you a random pill when picked up. An item only found in the boss room pool

collectibles.name: Torn Photo
collectibles.description: +0.7 Tears Up. +0.16 Shot Speed Up

collectibles.name: Blue Cap
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. +0.7 Tears Up. -0.16 Shot Speed Down. Heals one red heart container when picked up. An item only found in the Boss Room pool. Counts as 1 of 3 mushroom items needed towards the Fun Guy transformation

collectibles.name: Latch Key
collectibles.description: +1 Luck Up. +1 Soul Heart. Spawns 2 keys on the ground

collectibles.name: Match Book
collectibles.description: +1 Black Heart. +3 Bombs. When depleted, Black Hearts deal 40 damage to the entire room, in a Necronomicon style effect. REPENTANCE - Also drops the Match Stick trinket

collectibles.name: Synthoil
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. +1.5 Range Up. Counts as 1 of 3 syringe items needed towards the Spun transformation

collectibles.name: A Snack
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up. Heals one red heart container when picked up

collectibles.name: Diplopia
collectibles.description: A one-time use item which when used, will duplicate any pedestal items or consumables in the current room. If used in a shop, the duplicated items can be taken for free. If used on a trinket, another random trinket will spawn instead of a duplicate.

collectibles.name: Placebo
