collectibles.description: Only found in the Mausoleum/Gehenna II boss room. The item itself has no effect, but triggers the ascent through the backwards path towards the Home floor.

collectibles.name: Sausage
collectibles.description: +1 HP. +0.2 Speed Up. +0.5 Tears Up. +0.5 Damage Up. +1.5 Range Up. +0.16 Shot Speed Up. +1 Luck Up. +6.9% Devil/Angel Room chance. +6.9% Planetarium chance

collectibles.name: Options?
collectibles.description: Clearing a room will spawn an extra reward, however only one can be picked up - the other one will disappear

collectibles.name: Candy Heart
collectibles.description: Every half red heart you pick up gives a small but permanent stat increase. Randomly picks between +0.10 Damage Up, +0.05 Tears Up, +0.15 Range Up, +0.02 Speed Up, +0.1 Luck Up, +0.02 Shot Speed Up per half red heart. Spawns 1 Red Heart when picked up

collectibles.name: A Pound of Flesh
collectibles.description: This item causes Devil deals to cost money instead of hearts, and shop items to cost hearts instead of money. Shop items cost heart containers, and pickups have spikes around them. The Devil deal conversion rate is 1 heart container to 15 coins.

collectibles.name: Redemption
collectibles.description: Every time you enter a devil room and choose not to take an item, you get +1 Damage Up upon entering the next floor. The effect is shown via a cross above Isaac's head. Taking a Devil deal breaks the cross and prevents the damage up next floor.

collectibles.name: Spirit Shackles
collectibles.description: When you die, you turn into a ghost with 1/2 a red heart and flying, that is chained to your body for 10 seconds. This allows you to stay alive as long as you don't get hit during this 10 second period.

collectibles.name: Cracked Orb
collectibles.description: Taking damage reveals a random room on the minimap, and automatically opens certain doors in the current room. Possible doors include any needing a key to open (Item Room, Shop, Alt Path doors), secret rooms and crawl spaces.

collectibles.name: Empty Heart
collectibles.description: Upon entering each new floor, if you have one red heart or less, another one is added. This effect works while moving up floors in the backwards path. This item has no effect for characters with non-red health i.e. ???, Keeper and The Forgotten

collectibles.name: Astral Projection
collectibles.description: The first time you take damage in a room, Isaac will become a ghost and time will stop for 3 seconds. During this ghost effect, you gain flight, spectral tears and the damage from the next hit you take is negated.

collectibles.name: C Section
collectibles.description: Your tears are replaced with a charge attack that fires a homing, spectral fetus. The fetus tears deal damage equal to 75% of your current tear damage while in contact with enemies, roughly 5 times per second.

collectibles.name: Lil Abaddon
collectibles.description: Gives you a familiar that can be charged up to release a black ring, that damages any enemies that touch it with rapid hits (similar to Maw of the Void / Athame effects). The effect does a decent amount of damage, but doesn't scale with your damage upgrades.

collectibles.name: Montezuma's Revenge
collectibles.description: While firing tears, you now charge up a poop attack for 3 seconds that when released, fires from Isaac's behind. The poop attack deals your current tear damage to any enemies caught in the blast.

collectibles.name: Lil Portal
collectibles.description: Gives Isaac a little portal familiar, that moves across the screen as you're firing. The portal will suck up any consumables and trinkets it travels over, causing it to become larger and deal more contact damage.

collectibles.name: Worm Friend
collectibles.description: You gain a familiar that lives under the floor. Every so often it will come up and attempt to grab onto a random enemy in the room, holding them in place and dealing damage. The Worm Friend deals 4 damage for 8 ticks total.

collectibles.name: Bone Spurs
collectibles.description: Enemies that die will leave behind 1-2 floating bone shards where they die, until you leave the room. Other enemies that touch the bone shards will take 3.5 damage, with a chance to either bounce off them or cause it to break and disappear

collectibles.name: Hungry Soul
collectibles.description: Each time an enemy dies, a friendly red soul appears. It will hunt down other enemies, dealing contact damage which scales with your tear damage. After 5 seconds the red soul explodes (Isaac doesn't take damage from this effect)

collectibles.name: Jar of Wisps
collectibles.description: When used, gives you number of blue flame orbitals based on the number shown over this item. It starts at 1, and increments each activation, giving you more familiars each time you use it.

collectibles.name: Soul Locket
collectibles.description: Spawns 1 soul heart on the floor. Soul hearts give you small permanent stat increases when picked up. Possible stats include +0.3 Range Up, +0.2 Luck Up, +0.2 Damage Up, +0.1 Tears Up, +0.04 Speed Up

collectibles.name: Friend Finder
collectibles.description: Spawns a random charmed enemy which fights by your side and copies your exact movements, similar to how Jacob & Esau work. The familiars fire tears at the same time as Isaac, and have a visible health bar showing how much damage they can take before dying

collectibles.name: Inner Child
collectibles.description: Gives you an extra life. You respawn as a tiny version of Isaac, with a greatly reduced hitbox and +0.2 Speed Up. When the effect activates you deal 35 damage to nearby enemies.

collectibles.name: Glitched Crown
collectibles.description: Item pedestals now cycle between 5 random items

collectibles.name: Belly Jelly
collectibles.description: Enemies that touch Isaac will now bounce off him and fly off in the opposite direction. Bounced enemies will take 10 damage if they slam into the wall. This item also gives a random chance for enemy shots to bounce off you without taking damage

collectibles.name: Sacred Orb
collectibles.description: Increases the quality of generated items. Rerolls items with a quality of 0 or 1. 33% chance to reroll items with a quality of 2. Quality is a hidden mechanic in Repetance for all items and ranges from 0-4.

collectibles.name: Sanguine Bond
collectibles.description: Spawns a special set of spikes in the Devil Room. Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to spawn a reward. Nothing - 37.5% chance. 6 Pennies - 17% chance. +0.5 Damage Up - 27.5% chance. 2 Black Hearts - 9.5% chance. Random Item - 5.5% chance.

collectibles.name: The Swarm
collectibles.description: When picked up, this gives you 9 orbital flies. Each time a fly blocks an enemy shot, it will turn into a blue fly and attack nearby enemies, leaving you with one less orbital. Every room clear gives you +1 orbital fly, up to a maximum of 9.

collectibles.name: Heartbreak
collectibles.description: Gives you +0.25 Damage Up for every broken heart you have. Gives 3 broken hearts when picked up. Every hit of damage that would kill you, instead adds 2 more broken hearts and deal 40 damage to all enemies in the room. Heartbreak cannot kill you on pickup.

collectibles.name: Bloody Gust
collectibles.description: Every time you take damage, you gain a Speed Up and a Tears Up. The stat increases start small, and scale up each time you take damage (+0.25 Tears Up for the first hit, +0.75 Tears Up for the 6th hit).

collectibles.name: Salvation
collectibles.description: Isaac gains a halo of light around him. When an enemy touches the halo for couple of seconds, a beam of light will come down and deal a burst of damage to it. The triggered beam also fires in all 4 cardinal directions, dealing damage to anything it touches.

collectibles.name: Vanishing Twin
collectibles.description: A fetus familiar follows Isaac, and upon entering the Boss room on each floor, it will transform into a copy of the boss. This makes bosses a lot harder, however you now get 2 boss item drops

collectibles.name: Twisted Pair
collectibles.description: You gain two familiar demons, that stay by Isaac's side and fire shots in the same direction as you. The familiars deal roughly 40% of Isaac's damage, scaling with damage upgrades you get.

collectibles.name: Azazel's Rage
collectibles.description: Isaac builds rage each time you clear a new room. This is shown by the Azazel skin spreading on Isaac's face. After 4 rooms, Isaac's face will flash red.

collectibles.name: Echo Chamber
collectibles.description: When using a card, pill, or rune, you also use a copy of the last 3 cards/pills/runes you used after picking up Echo Chamber. Counts as 1 of 3 astrology items needed in the same run to unlock Planetariums
collectibles.quote: I can see see the future future future

collectibles.name: Isaac's Tomb
collectibles.description: Spawns an Old chest at the start of all future floors. Old Chests work the same as Golden Chests, requiring a key to open but contain different items.

collectibles.name: Vengeful Spirit
collectibles.description: Each time you take damage, a red flame orbital will appear around Isaac for the remainder of the floor, up to a maximum of 6. The flames deal contact damage which scales with your tear damage.

collectibles.name: Esau Jr.
collectibles.description: Using this item swaps you between the character you started as, and Esau, which has 3 black hearts, +2 base damage and the ability to fly. This character keeps its own separate health and items. Items picked up are not shared between the two characters.

collectibles.name: Berserk!
collectibles.description: When activated, Isaac's tears are replaced by a bone sword and he goes on a killing rampage, gaining +0.4 Speed, +3 Flat Damage Up for 5 seconds. The sword deals x3 damage if used at close range, or x1.5 damage if charged up and thrown.

collectibles.name: Dark Arts
collectibles.description: When used, Isaac turns into a ghost for 1 second and his speed goes up to maximum (2.0). During this time he can walk over enemies to mark them for death.

collectibles.name: Abyss
collectibles.description: When used, Abyss consumes all pedestal items in the current room and converts them into Red attack flies. Red attack flies will charge across the room in the same direction Isaac is shooting, dealing contact damage to enemies equal to Isaac's tear damage.

collectibles.name: Supper
collectibles.description: +1 HP Up

collectibles.name: Stapler
collectibles.description: +1.0 Damage Up. Staples one of Isaac's eyes shut, meaning he only shoots tears from one eye. This means some effects such as R U A WIZARD pills only fire tears in one direction

collectibles.name: Suplex!
collectibles.description: When used, you charge forwards for a second. If you touch an enemy in that time, Isaac will pick it up and slam it on the ground, killing it and sending a shockwave around the impact.

collectibles.name: Bag of Crafting
collectibles.description: When used will do a swipe attack in any direction. Can be used to store up to 8 consumables in, such as hearts, coins, keys, bombs, cards etc.

collectibles.name: Flip
collectibles.description: While holding flip, a ghost item will appear behind item pedestals upon entering Item Rooms and Shop that cannot be interacted with. When activated, all real items in the room will be swapped with the ghost items behind them.

collectibles.name: Lemegeton
collectibles.description: When used, gives you an orbital flame which represents another random passive item in the game. While you have this flame you also have that item's effect.

collectibles.name: Sumptorium
collectibles.description: When used, removes half a heart of health and creates a clot familiar. Clot familiars follow Isaac's exact movements including flight, firing tears and tear effects. Holding down the swap button will cause all your clots to stay in place.

collectibles.name: Recall
collectibles.description: When used, this will retreive the Tainted Forgotten's skeleton back to its owner's hands from any distance. Tainted Forgotten's Birthright effect. Cannot be obtained and has no use for any other character.

collectibles.name: Hold
collectibles.description: This is the item Tainted Blue Baby (???) uses as his main mechanic. Killing or damaging enemies spawns various poops, which add to his collection. Pressing the bomb button will put the next poop into the 'Hold' jar.

collectibles.name: Keeper's Sack
collectibles.description: Spawns 3 random coins and a key when picked up. Buying items from the shop gives you random stat upgrades. The more you spend the higher the stat increase. Possible stats include Speed, Damage and Range.

collectibles.name: Keeper's Kin
collectibles.description: While in a room with enemies, blue spiders will randomly spawn from objects in the room (e.g. rocks, pots, stone blocks). All rocks spawn 0-2 blue spiders when destroyed. Counts as 1 of 3 spider items needed towards the Spider Baby transformation.

collectibles.name: Keeper's Box
collectibles.description: When used, spawns a random shop item or consumable, however you have to pay the relevant cost to pick it up. Can include anything that would appear in the shop

collectibles.name: Everything Jar
collectibles.description: With every bar of charge this item has, a different consumable is shown inside the Jar. 1 = poop, 2 = penny, 3 = bomb, 4 = key, 5 = red heart, 6 = pill, 7 = card, 8 = soul heart, 9 = gold heart, 10 = gold key, 11 = gold bomb.

collectibles.name: TMTRAINER
collectibles.description: When picked up, all future items become 'glitched', causing them to become random combinations of 2-3 effects based on other items.
collectibles.quote: Isaac and his mother lived alone in a small house on a hill

collectibles.name: Anima Sola
collectibles.description: When used, it puts the closes enemy in chains for 5 seconds, preventing it from moving. You can release the enemy early by using it again. Tainted Jacob starts with this item. While playing as him Anima Sola will always target Dark Esau.

collectibles.name: Spindown Dice
collectibles.description: Rerolls all pedestal items, lowering all their internal item IDs by 1. For example: Brimstone's ID = 118, so it would be rerolled into Dead Bird (ID = 117). Sad Onion (ID = 1) will reroll into nothing.

collectibles.name: Hypercoagulation
collectibles.description: Upon taking damage you have a chance to drop the heart that you just lost. It gives you 2 seconds to pick it up again to re-heal, before it disappears

collectibles.name: IBS
collectibles.description: Whenever you deal damage to an enemy, has a chance to give the effect of one of Tainted ???'s unique poops. Corn poop - Spawns a blue fly every 2 seconds. Flaming poop - Leaves behind fire that damages enemies. Stinky poop - Emits a toxic cloud.

collectibles.name: Hemoptysis
collectibles.description: Allows you to quickly double tap a shoot button to sneeze on nearby enemies, dealing x1.5 your tear damage and pushing them back slightly. If an enemy is pushed into a wall or object it takes 10 damage

collectibles.name: Ghost Bombs
collectibles.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs become spectral and can now pass through objects. Bombs spawn a friendly white soul, which will hunt down other enemies, dealing contact damage which scales with your tear damage.

collectibles.name: Gello
collectibles.description: Spawns a familiar that's attached via an Umbilical Cord, but will move and shoot in the same direction Isaac is shooting. When activated you first need to throw the familiar, which deals x3 your tear damage to any enemies it touches.

collectibles.name: Decap Attack
collectibles.description: When used, this item allows you to throw your head where it will sit as a stationary sentry firing bullets until you walk over and pick it up again. Throwing Isaac's head deals 24 damage to anything it hits while being thrown.

collectibles.name: Glass Eye
collectibles.description: +0.75 Damage Up. +1 Luck Up

collectibles.name: Stye
collectibles.description: +28% Damage Up (right eye only). +7 Range Up (right eye only). -0.3 Shot Speed Down (right eye only)

collectibles.name: Mom's Ring
collectibles.description: +1 Damage Up. Drops 1 random rune or soul stone when picked up. Counts as 1 of 3 mom items needed towards the Mom transformation

trinkets.name: Swallowed Penny
trinkets.description: Each time you get hit, you drop a coin or two

trinkets.name: Petrified Poop
trinkets.description: While held, Isaac has a significantly higher chance to find drops when breaking poops

trinkets.name: AAA Battery
trinkets.description: Lowers your spacebar item charge rate by 1. Cannot lower the charge of your spacebar item below 1 room. For example, you will now be able to use a 3 room charge item after 2 rooms instead

trinkets.name: Broken Remote
trinkets.description: Does the teleport effect every time you use your current spacebar item. Can be used infinitely every room if you have Guppy's Paw and no red heart containers (Can be exploited to get to the boss room without clearing any other rooms)

trinkets.name: Purple Heart
trinkets.description: Higher chance for champion enemies while held

trinkets.name: Broken Magnet
trinkets.description: Has a partial Magneto effect and will attract coins, pulling them into Isaac from a distance. Does not attract other pickups like the full Magneto item does

trinkets.name: Rosary Bead
trinkets.description: Increases your chances to find an Angel Room instead of a Devil Room. Normally there is a 50%/50% chance of a Angel or Devil room with if a door spawns after the boss. The Rosary Bead changes this to a 75%/25% chance of an angel or devil room (respectively)

trinkets.name: Cartridge
trinkets.description: When Isaac takes damage, there is a chance he will gain the Gamekid effect, turning him invincible and dealing contact damage to any enemies he touches.

trinkets.name: Pulse Worm
trinkets.description: Tears shrink and grow in size as they go across the room. Does not appear to affect your damage and only the hitbox size of tears

trinkets.name: Wiggle Worm
trinkets.description: Tears now move in a wave fashion across the room. Grants spectral tears. +0.4 Tears up

trinkets.name: Ring Worm
trinkets.description: While held, tears move in a spiral pattern across the screen at high speed. Grants spectral tears. +0.4 Tears up. Effectively increases your range due to the tear pattern

trinkets.name: Flat Worm
trinkets.description: Tears become flat and disc shaped giving them a larger hitbox. Higher knockback effect with your tears

trinkets.name: Store Credit
trinkets.description: While this trinket is held, all items in the Shop cost 0 coins. After buying any 0 cent item in the Shop, the trinket disappears

trinkets.name: Callus
trinkets.description: Isaac no longer takes damage from walking over spikes and blood creep while this trinket is held

trinkets.name: Lucky Rock
trinkets.description: 33% chance to drop a coin for every rock that you destroy

trinkets.name: Mom's Toenail
trinkets.description: Mom's Leg will now appear every 20 seconds and stomp down randomly in the room dealing 300 damage to enemies. Be warned though, Mom's leg can also stomp and hurt Isaac too!

trinkets.name: Black Lipstick
trinkets.description: Increases the chance for Black hearts to spawn

trinkets.name: Bible Tract
trinkets.description: Gives you a higher chance of eternal hearts. Contrary to popular belief, the Bible Tract doesn't allow Angel Rooms to appear after paying for a Devil Deal

trinkets.name: Paper Clip
trinkets.description: Allows you to unlock golden chests without needing a key. Does not work on locked rooms. Cain starts with this trinket after donating 68 coins to the Greed Donation Machine

trinkets.name: Monkey Paw
trinkets.description: When you reach half a heart of life remaining, a black heart will spawn. After three black hearts have spawned, the trinket dissapears

trinkets.name: Mysterious Paper
trinkets.description: Imitates the behaviours of some of the other 'paper' items/trinkets. A Missing Page: When taking damage, Isaac has a chance to deal damage to the entire room in a Necronomicon style effect.

trinkets.name: Daemon's Tail
trinkets.description: 80% of heart drops are replaced with keys. Hearts turn into black hearts where possible. This doesn't convert hearts that dropped before picking up this trinket, and doesn't apply to set heart drops, i.e.

trinkets.name: Missing Poster
trinkets.description: Dying in a sacrifice room while holding this trinket will unlock The Lost character. After The Lost is unlocked, dying anywhere with this trinket will bring you back to life as The Lost and the trinket will be deleted.

trinkets.name: Butt Penny
trinkets.description: Everytime you pick up a coin, you fart, inflicting poison damage to nearby enemies. Greatly increases the chance of coins dropping from poops

trinkets.name: Mysterious Candy
trinkets.description: Causes Isaac to create poops randomly

trinkets.name: Hook Worm
trinkets.description: Tears now move forwards at right angles, shifting left and right across the room. +0.4 Tears up. Grants spectral tears. Increases your range stat by +10.0 while held but due to the fire pattern, your tears travel a similar distance to normal

trinkets.name: Whip Worm
trinkets.description: +0.5 Shot Speed Up. Your tears now whip across the room at a very high shot speed. Shot speed gives your tears more effective range, but doesn't increase your range stat directly

trinkets.name: Broken Ankh
trinkets.description: Has a 22.22% chance to respawn with 3 Soul hearts as Blue Baby when you die

trinkets.name: Fish Head
trinkets.description: Everytime Isaac takes damage, one blue fly will spawn

trinkets.name: Pinky Eye
trinkets.description: Isaac's tears have a chance to poison enemies. The poison effect leaves a damage over time, which deals 4 or 6 damage per tick. The chance to poison enemies is affected by your luck stat and at +18 Luck it will activate every time

trinkets.name: Push Pin
trinkets.description: Isaac now has a chance to make a spectral and piercing tear. The chance to fire a piercing tear is affected by your luck stat and at +18 Luck it will activate every time

trinkets.name: Liberty Cap
trinkets.description: While held, this trinket gives a random mushroom effect each room. Possible mushrooms include: Mini Mush, Odd Mushroom (Thin), Odd Mushroom (Thick), The Compass

trinkets.name: Umbilical Cord
trinkets.description: While at 1/2 a red heart of health, you gain a Little Steve familiar that follows you and shoots homing tears. Umbilical Cord has a high chance to spawn a Gemini familiar for the room when Isaac takes damage. This effect is stackable

trinkets.name: Child's Heart
trinkets.description: Gives Isaac a higher chance to find hearts from drops after clearing a room and from chests
trinkets.quote: It calls out to its brothers

trinkets.name: Curved Horn
trinkets.description: +2 Damage Up

trinkets.name: Rusted Key
trinkets.description: Gives Isaac a higher chance to find keys and chests

trinkets.name: Goat Hoof
trinkets.description: +0.15 Speed Up

trinkets.name: Mom's Pearl
trinkets.description: Grants a secondary chance of any non-specific heart drop turning into a soul heart

trinkets.name: Cancer
trinkets.description: -2 Tear Delay (Tears Up). The fire rate increase is applied in such a way that the higher your tear stat is, the more effective Cancer is. Breaks the normal fire rate cap, allowing you to fire faster than the normal maximum

trinkets.name: Red Patch
trinkets.description: You have a chance when taking damage to gain +1.8 Damage Up for the rest of the room

trinkets.name: Match Stick
trinkets.description: Gives Isaac a higher chance to find bombs. Picking up the Match Stick is the only way to remove the Tick trinket

trinkets.name: Lucky Toe
trinkets.description: +1 Luck Up while held

trinkets.name: Cursed Skull
trinkets.description: When you take damage while on 1/2 a heart, you are teleported back to the previous room

trinkets.name: Safety Cap
trinkets.description: Gives Isaac a higher chance to find pills

trinkets.name: Ace of Spades
trinkets.description: Gives Isaac a higher chance to find Tarot cards after clearing a room or from chests

trinkets.name: Isaac's Fork
trinkets.description: After clearing a room, you have a chance to heal for half a red heart

trinkets.name: A Missing Page
trinkets.description: When taking damage, Isaac has a chance to deal damage to the entire room in a Necronomicon style effect. The chance to damage enemies is affected by your luck stat and at +50 or more Luck it will activate 50% of the time

trinkets.name: Bloody Penny
trinkets.description: Everytime you pick up a penny, you have a 25% chance to spawn a red heart on the floor

trinkets.name: Burnt Penny
trinkets.description: Everytime you pick up a coin, you have a 25% chance to spawn a bomb on the floor

trinkets.name: Flat Penny
trinkets.description: Everytime you pick up a coin, you have a 25% chance to spawn a key

trinkets.name: Counterfeit Penny
trinkets.description: When picking up a coin, you have a chance to automatically gain one more coin

trinkets.name: Tick
trinkets.description: When you enter a boss room, immediately remove 15% health from the boss and restore 1 red heart. This trinket cannot be dropped by holding the drop key or picking up other trinkets.

trinkets.name: Isaac's Head
trinkets.description: While held, this trinket gives Isaac a familiar that shoots piercing tears that deal 3.5 damage

trinkets.name: Maggy's Faith
trinkets.description: At the start of a new floor, you get an eternal heart

trinkets.name: Judas' Tongue
trinkets.description: Items which cost 2 heart containers in a deal with the devil are reduced to only cost 1 heart

trinkets.name: ???'s Soul
trinkets.description: Creates a familiar which moves around the room in a similar fashion to The Peeper, shooting tears in the same direction as Isaac

trinkets.name: Samson's Lock
trinkets.description: When you kill an enemy, you have a chance to get +0.5 damage up for the current room

trinkets.name: Cain's Eye
trinkets.description: Gives a 25% chance to reveal map icons at the start of a new floor (The same effect as the Compass)

trinkets.name: Eve's Bird Foot
trinkets.description: When you kill an enemy, you have a chance to spawn a transparent Dead Bird familiar. The Dead Bird familiar deals 2 damage per tick to enemies while in contact with them

trinkets.name: The Left Hand
trinkets.description: Replaces chest spawns with red chests. Doesn't replace chests that have already spawned
trinkets.quote: The left hand path reaps dark rewards

trinkets.name: Shiny Rock
trinkets.description: While held, tinted rocks and rocks with a crawlspace below them will flash white every 10 seconds

trinkets.name: Safety Scissors
trinkets.description: Turns all troll bombs into bombs which you can pick up and use. Super Troll bombs turn into 1+1 free double bomb pickups

trinkets.name: Rainbow Worm
trinkets.description: Gives your tears a random worm effect every few seconds. The possible tear effects include: Whip Worm, Ring Worm, Wiggle Worm, Flat Worm, Hook Worm, Pulse Worm, Tape Worm and Lazy Worm

trinkets.name: Tape Worm
trinkets.description: While held, Tape Worm doubles your range stat and halves your tear height stat

trinkets.name: Lazy Worm
trinkets.description: -0.4 Shot Speed Down

trinkets.name: Cracked Dice
trinkets.description: Every time you get hit, you have a chance to activate the D6, D20, D8, D10 or D12 effect

trinkets.name: Super Magnet
trinkets.description: While held this trinket causes all pickups and enemies to move slowly towards you. Will also attract the Mom's Foot and Ultra Greed door entities

trinkets.name: Faded Polaroid
trinkets.description: Randomly Isaac will gain a camouflage for a few seconds and all enemies in the current room will have a confused status effect applied to them. This trinket can be used to open the door to Mausoleum in Depths II

trinkets.name: Louse
trinkets.description: Gives a small chance to spawn a friendly attack spider while in a hostile room with enemies

trinkets.name: Bob's Bladder
trinkets.description: Leaves a pool of green creep under all bombs you place, which damages enemies that walk over it

trinkets.name: Watch Battery
trinkets.description: Gives a +6.66% chance of a getting a small battery after clearing a room. Gives a +2.0% chance for pickups to be small batteries. Gives a +5.0% chance to add an extra charge to your active item after clearing a room

trinkets.name: Blasting Cap
trinkets.description: Exploding bombs now have a chance to drop another bomb that you can pick up

trinkets.name: Stud Finder
trinkets.description: Higher chance to find crawl spaces when exploding rocks

trinkets.name: Error
trinkets.description: Gives a different trinket effect per room, randomly choosing between any of the other available trinkets in the game. Each room is locked to a specific trinket effect, meaning if you exit and re-enter a room, that specific room will always have the same effect

trinkets.name: Poker Chip
trinkets.description: Chests now have a 50/50 chance to either pay out with extra consumables or nothing/an enemy

trinkets.name: Blister
trinkets.description: Tears have a stronger knockback effect while this trinket is held

trinkets.name: Second Hand
trinkets.description: Increases the time that status effects stay on enemies. e.g. With poison effects, the damage over time poison will last for much longer

trinkets.name: Endless Nameless
trinkets.description: While held there is a small chance when using a tarot card or pill that a copy of it will be dropped on the floor next to you

trinkets.name: Black Feather
trinkets.description: +0.2 Damage Up for each 'evil' item you have. Items classed as evil in this case are Black Candle, Ceremonial Robes, Abaddon, Goat Head, Match Book, Missing Page 2, Safety Pin

trinkets.name: Blind Rage
trinkets.description: Invincibility lasts longer after getting hit (Increased i-frames). This makes it possible to use the Blood Donation machine twice from one hit of damage

trinkets.name: Golden Horse Shoe
trinkets.description: +15% chance to get a double item room to spawn on the next floor. If the effect activates, two items spawn in your item room, however only one can be taken (Same effect as the More Options item). The chance doubles to +30% with the effect from Mom's Box

trinkets.name: Store Key
trinkets.description: Automatically opens all shop room doors for free

trinkets.name: Rib of Greed
trinkets.description: Forces the Greed and Super Greed mini bosses to no longer appear in shops or secret rooms. Holding Rib of Greed increase your chance to receive coin drops

trinkets.name: Karma
trinkets.description: Donating to a Donation Machine has a chance to heal Isaac for a full red heart or spawn a Beggar. Can't spawn in greed mode

trinkets.name: Lil Larva
trinkets.description: Destroying poops now gives you a blue fly

trinkets.name: Mom's Locket
trinkets.description: While held, you heal for half a red heart every time you use a key to open a door or golden chest. Changes all half red hearts into full hearts. Hearts dropped from Tainted Magdalene's mechanic will be always full red hearts

trinkets.name: NO!
trinkets.description: While this trinket is held you have a significantly lower chance to find spacebar/active items. It will cause passive items to spawn except when the game cannot generate any more passive items and will then instead choose spacebar/active items.

trinkets.name: Child Leash
trinkets.description: Causes your familiars to stay closer to each other

trinkets.name: Brown Cap
trinkets.description: Poop in the environment will now explode when destroyed

trinkets.name: Meconium
trinkets.description: While held you have an increased chance for Black Poops to spawn, which deal damage to all enemies in the room when destroyed. Gives The Poop active item a chance to spawn a Black Poop too

trinkets.name: Cracked Crown
trinkets.description: Boosts speed, range, shot speed, tears and damage if they are above their base values by roughly +20%. Affects stat bonuses from passive items, trinkets that are absorbed or in a second trinket slot, and permanent bonuses given by items such as Void

trinkets.name: Used Diaper
trinkets.description: While held, gives the Skatole effect only in certain rooms, which will turn hostile flies to neutral and stop others from shooting. Attack, Dart and Ring Flies turn into neutral Black Flies and Pooters and Fat Flies will no longer fire at you

trinkets.name: Fish Tail
trinkets.description: Items and trinkets which generate blue flies and spiders will have double the effect, causing twice as many to spawn

trinkets.name: Black Tooth
trinkets.description: Some tears will randomly become a black tooth, that deal double your normal tear damage and can poison enemies

trinkets.name: Ouroboros Worm
trinkets.description: Tears become spectral and travel in a huge spiral pattern. +1.5 Range Up. +0.4 Tears up

trinkets.name: Tonsil
trinkets.description: Every time you take damage you have a very small chance to gain a Tonsil familiar, which follows you and blocks enemy projectiles. This effect can happen twice before the Tonsil trinket is destroyed. Does not deal contact damage to enemies

trinkets.name: Nose Goblin
trinkets.description: Your tears have a random chance to become booger tears. Booger tears stick on to enemies and deal periodic poison damage until they die or 60 seconds passes. Each tick of poison damage is equal to your normal tear damage. The boogers will have a homing effect

trinkets.name: Super Ball
trinkets.description: Some random tears will gain the Rubber Cement effect and become bouncy

trinkets.name: Vibrant Bulb
trinkets.description: Grants +0.25 Speed, +0.75 Range, +0.1 Shot Speed, +0.2 Tears, +0.5 Damage and +1 Luck when Isaac's active item is fully charged. Infinite use items such as Potato Peeler count as charged and provide the bonus from this trinket

trinkets.name: Dim Bulb
trinkets.description: Grants +0.5 Speed, +1.5 Range, +0.3 Shot Speed, +0.4 Tears, +1.5 Damage when Isaac's active item is completely uncharged. One-time use items such as Mama Mega count as uncharged and provide the bonus from this trinket

trinkets.name: Fragmented Card
trinkets.description: Gives you another secret room on each new floor while held. Does not spawn more than one super secret room, only the normal secret room

trinkets.name: Equality!
trinkets.description: When you have the same amount of coins, bombs and keys, half consumables turn into their doubled version. This effect works for any number of consumables, including 0 and 99, as long as the count for coins/keys/bombs is equal

trinkets.name: Wish Bone
trinkets.description: Every time you take damage you have a very small chance to spawn a random pedestal item. When the effect triggers, the trinket is destroyed

trinkets.name: Bag Lunch
trinkets.description: Every time you take damage you have a very small chance to spawn the Lunch item, which gives +1 HP up. When the effect triggers, this trinket is destroyed

trinkets.name: Lost Cork
trinkets.description: Increases the radius of any creep you produce

trinkets.name: Crow Heart
trinkets.description: While held, any damage taken remove red hearts first, before soul hearts, black hearts and rotten heart damage. While at 1/2 of a red heart, it will begin to remove your other hearts again

trinkets.name: Walnut
trinkets.description: The Walnut has a chance to break when taking damage from an explosion. If it does, it will drop a random trinket, coin, heart and key. The Walnut trinket is destroyed once the effect activates
trinkets.quote: Thats a hard nut to crack!

trinkets.name: Duct Tape
trinkets.description: Causes any orbitals you have to stop moving while held. Stops shooting familiars from moving (including Lilith's Incubus).

trinkets.name: Silver Dollar
trinkets.description: While held, shops will now appear on the womb floors (The Womb, Utero and Scarred Womb)

trinkets.name: Bloody Crown
trinkets.description: While held, item rooms now appear on the womb floors (The Womb, Utero and Scarred Womb). Causes item rooms to appear on the Corpse floors

trinkets.name: Pay To Win
trinkets.description: While held, restock boxes will always spawn in item rooms

trinkets.name: Locust of War
trinkets.description: Upon entering a room with enemies, spawns a Red Locust which detonates upon impact with enemies, dealing double tear damage for the impact of the Locust and 60 damage for the explosion.

trinkets.name: Locust of Pestilence
trinkets.description: At the start of each new hostile room you spawn a green attack fly, which will target a nearby enemy, deal double your tear damage and then poison them

trinkets.name: Locust of Famine
trinkets.description: At the start of each new hostile room you spawn a yellow attack fly, which will target a nearby enemy, deal double your tear damage and apply a slowing effect to it

trinkets.name: Locust of Death
trinkets.description: Upon entering a room with enemies, spawns a Black Locust that deals quadruple Isaac's damage, applied as two hits of double damage

trinkets.name: Locust of Conquest
trinkets.description: At the start of each new hostile room you spawn 2-5 white attack flies, which will target a nearby enemy and deal double your tear damage to it

trinkets.name: Bat Wing
trinkets.description: When killing an enemy, you have a very small chance to gain the ability to fly for the rest of the room

trinkets.name: Stem Cell
trinkets.description: Stem Cell heals Isaac's red heart containers to 50% each floor. If Isaac already has 50% health or more, it heals half of a heart instead

trinkets.name: Hairpin
trinkets.description: Fully recharges your active item at the start of each boss fight. Added as part of the Afterbirth+ Booster Pack #1 and based on the Steam Workshop mod created by Zaratus

trinkets.name: Wooden Cross
trinkets.description: Gives you the Holy Mantle shield effect at the start of every new floor, which protects you from the next hit of damage you take. Does not recharge until the start of the next floor.

trinkets.name: Butter!
trinkets.description: Using your active item while holding this trinket will drop it back on a pedestal on the ground. Also after taking damage, you have a very small chance to drop one of your passive items. One-time use active items will be consumed and not dropped.

trinkets.name: Filigree Feather
trinkets.description: Holding this trinket will cause the Angel mini bosses to drop normal items instead of Key Pieces. Added as part of the Afterbirth+ Booster Pack #2, designed by Edmund McMillen

trinkets.name: Door Stop
trinkets.description: While held, the last door Isaac went through stays open, allowing him to leave the room even if enemies are in it. This trinket works on boss rooms (except Ultra Greed) and devil rooms containing Krampus, allowing you to exit out mid-fight.

trinkets.name: Extension Cord
trinkets.description: After being picked up, a yellow laser chain now flows through Isaac's familiars. Added as part of the Afterbirth+ Booster Pack #4 and based on the Steam Workshop mod created by Strawrat and Aczom

trinkets.name: Rotten Penny
trinkets.description: While held, spawns +1 friendly blue fly every time you pick up a coin. Added as part of the Afterbirth+ Booster Pack #5. Based on the Steam Workshop mod created by Eufuu

trinkets.name: Baby-Bender
trinkets.description: While held this trinket gives your familiars homing shots. Added as part of the Afterbirth+ Booster Pack #5. Based on the Steam Workshop mod created by Ink Tears

trinkets.name: Finger Bone
trinkets.description: While held, gives you a 5% chance to gain a bone heart everytime you take damage. Added as part of the Afterbirth+ Booster Pack #5

trinkets.name: Jawbreaker
trinkets.description: Tears have a chance to become a tooth, dealing x3.2 damage, similar to Tough Love. The chance to fire a tooth with this trinket is affected by your Luck stat. At +0 luck you have ~12% chance for this effect to activate.

trinkets.name: Chewed Pen
trinkets.description: Tears have a chance to slow enemies

trinkets.name: Blessed Penny
trinkets.description: Chance to spawn half a soul heart when picking up a coin. The chance scales up based on the coin's worth: Penny = 16.66%, Double Penny = 30.5%, Nickel = 59.7%, Dime = 83.3%

trinkets.name: Broken Syringe
trinkets.description: Gives you a random syringe effect every room. The effect can be The Virus, Roid Rage, Speed Ball, Experimental Treatment, Synthoil, Euthanasia or Growth Hormones

trinkets.name: Short Fuse
trinkets.description: Placed bombs explode after 0.66 seconds instead of the usual 1.5 seconds. This was called Exploded Firecracker in Antibirth

trinkets.name: Gigante Bean
trinkets.description: Farts produced by Isaac or familiars will be twice as large

trinkets.name: A Lighter
trinkets.description: Chance for enemies to burn when entering a room. The chance for this effect to activate is effected by your Luck stat

trinkets.name: Broken Padlock
trinkets.description: Explosions can open locked doors. This includes key blocks and golden chests

trinkets.name: Myosotis
trinkets.description: Pickups left on current floor will appear in the starting room of the next floor, up to a maximum of 4 pickups

trinkets.name: 'M
trinkets.description: Active items will be rerolled upon using them. Using with Book of Virtues will only reroll the item the book is holding. Has no effect with Notched Axe due to how its durability works

trinkets.name: Teardrop Charm
trinkets.description: Random luck-based tear effects have an extra chance of occurring. The additional chance is effectively +3 Luck Up

trinkets.name: Apple of Sodom
trinkets.description: Picking up red hearts now has a high chance to spawn 1-4 blue attack spiders, instead of giving you health back. This effect also works while fully healed, giving a guaranteed chance of getting spiders.

trinkets.name: Forgotten Lullaby
trinkets.description: Gives your familiars improved rate of fire while held. In Antibirth this trinket was called Song of the Siren

trinkets.name: Beth's Faith
trinkets.description: While held at the start of each floor, this trinket spawns four wisp familiar orbitals around Isaac. These wisps are the same as the ones created by the Book of Virtues item

trinkets.name: Old Capacitor
trinkets.description: Your active item no longer gains charges, but battery drops become much more common

trinkets.name: Brain Worm
trinkets.description: Tears that miss enemies will redirect themselves and travel 90 degrees towards enemies. Tears must be roughly 2 tiles or closer to activate this effect

trinkets.name: Perfection
trinkets.description: +10 Luck while held, but the trinket is destroyed when damage is taken. Blood donation machines, Curse Rooms and Sacrifice Rooms wont destroy it. Taking a hit and activating Holy Mantle won't destroy it. Can be dropped in order to avoid breaking it.
trinkets.quote: Luck way up. Don't lose it!

trinkets.name: Devil's Crown
trinkets.description: Treasure Rooms are replaced with Red Treasure Rooms, which contain a deal with the devil in place of a regular item pedestal.

trinkets.name: Charged Penny
trinkets.description: Every time you pick up a coin, you have a small chance to gain 1 bar of charge on your active item. The chance for this effect to happen is 1/6th of the value of the coin picked up. Can only activate once per coin collected.

trinkets.name: Friendship Necklace
trinkets.description: While held, your familiars will now orbit around Isaac instead of following behind him

trinkets.name: Panic Button
trinkets.description: Activates your active item just before damage would be taken. It doesn't activate for free - the charges are used up as normal if this effect activates. This means the trinket does nothing if your active item isn't fully charged.

trinkets.name: Blue Key
trinkets.description: Doors can be opened without using up a key. However, when entering the door you are taken to a blue womb room with enemies to defeat. This room will always drop a reward at the end, then allow you to exit back to the real floor

trinkets.name: Flat File
trinkets.description: While held this trinket causes spikes to retract into the floor. Works for curse rooms - you no longer take damage entering or leaving. Allows you to open spiked chests without taking damage

trinkets.name: Telescope Lens
trinkets.description: +9% chance for a Planetarium to spawn. Allows Planetariums to spawn in the Womb/Utero floors. Planetarium have a base 1% chance to appear, which increases by +20% whenever you skip an Item Room (Must not enter to count as skipped).

trinkets.name: Mom's Lock
trinkets.description: Has a high chance to give you the effect of a random Mom item every room

trinkets.name: Dice Bag
trinkets.description: Every time you enter a brand new room, you have a chance to get a random one-time use Dice (e.g. D6, D20 etc.)

trinkets.name: Holy Crown
trinkets.description: Causes Item rooms and Shops to appear in the Cathedral
trinkets.quote: Walk the path of the saint

trinkets.name: Mother's Kiss
trinkets.description: While held you get +1 HP Up. The first time you pick this trinket up, the heart container will be filled. This effect can't be abused - next time it will be empty if dropped

trinkets.name: Torn Card
trinkets.description: Every 15 shots you will shoot an Ipecac + My Reflection shot. The tear will fly in the air for about 3 seconds and follows Isaac until it falls and explodes.

trinkets.name: Torn Pocket
trinkets.description: Every time you take damage, you drop up to 2 different types of consumables on the ground. Dropped consumables can be any variant of its kind - e.g. a bomb can become a troll bomb, or a dropped coin can become a dime. Does nothing if you have no consumables

trinkets.name: Gilded Key
trinkets.description: All new chests become locked Golden chests

trinkets.name: Lucky Sack
trinkets.description: Spawns a sack at the start of each new floor

trinkets.name: Wicked Crown
trinkets.description: Causes an Item Room and Shop to appear in Sheol
trinkets.quote: Walk the path of the wicked

trinkets.name: Azazel's Stump
trinkets.description: When entering a new room, gives a small chance to gain Azazel's short-range Brimstone laser for the current room and the ability to fly

trinkets.name: Dingle Berry
trinkets.description: Spawns 2 friendly Dips upon clearing a room. Dips that spawn after killing a Squirt turn friendly

trinkets.name: Ring Cap
trinkets.description: Drops 2 bombs at once (only 1 bomb is removed from your total)

trinkets.name: Nuh Uh!
trinkets.description: Beyond the womb floor, replaces all coin and key spawns with a random pickup as follows:. Bomb - 26.6% chance. Heart - 26.6% chance. Pill - 16.6% chance. Card - 16.6% chance. Trinket - 6.6% chance. Battery - 6.6% chance.

trinkets.name: Modeling Clay
trinkets.description: Each brand new room, this trinket has a chance to transform into a copy of a random passive item, which gives you the effect for the duration of this room

trinkets.name: Polished Bone
trinkets.description: Gives a small chance to spawn a friendly Bony when clearing a room, which will throw bones at enemies until it takes enough damage to die. Can be either the regular white Bony or the black variant

trinkets.name: Hollow Heart
trinkets.description: Gives you +1 Bone Heart every time you enter a new floor

trinkets.name: Kid's Drawing
trinkets.description: Counts as 1 of 3 cat items needed towards the Guppy transformation. Dropping this trinket again removes the transformation if you dont have 3 other Guppy items

trinkets.name: Crystal Key
trinkets.description: Each time you clear a room there is a chance a Red Room will spawn at one of the walls.. The chance for a Red Room to unlock increases as you pick up more Crystal Keys.. While in a regular room, the chances to spawn a Red Room are: 1 Key = 33.33% chance.

trinkets.name: Keeper's Bargain
trinkets.description: Has a decent chance for Devil Deals to cost money instead of Health. The conversion rate is 1 heart container to 15 coins. Items can be on discount similar to the shop, making it 1 heart container = 7 coins instead. No effect on Lost or Tainted Lost.

trinkets.name: Cursed Penny
trinkets.description: While held, you will be teleported to a random room everytime you pick up a coin

trinkets.name: Your Soul
trinkets.description: Allows you to pay for a devil deal with this trinket

trinkets.name: Number Magnet
trinkets.description: +10% devil room chance while held. Changes Devil Room layouts. The new rooms contain 0-3 Devil Deal Items, 1-3 Black Hearts and random enemies from the Sheol floor. Prevents Krampus from appearing

trinkets.name: Strange Key
trinkets.description: Opens the door to the Blue Womb, regardless of whether you meet the 30 minute speed timer. Opening Pandora's Box while holding this item will ignore the normal effect and instead spawn 6 item pedestals from random item pools.

trinkets.name: Lil Clot
trinkets.description: A small clot friend will hug Isaac, following his exact movements (similar to how Jacob & Esau work) and shooting tears when he does. The clot can be moved around by collision with an object/wall, allowing you to re-position it.

trinkets.name: Temporary Tattoo
trinkets.description: Spawns a random chest after completing a regular Challenge Room. Spawns a pedestal item after completing a boss Challenge Room. Doesn't spawn in Greed Mode

trinkets.name: Swallowed M80
trinkets.description: When taking damage you have a chance to explode and deal 185 damage to all enemies around you (Same damage as a Mr. Mega bomb)

trinkets.name: RC Remote
trinkets.description: Familiars follow Isaac's exact movements, (similar to how Jacob & Esau work) instead of following loosely like they usually do. Holding the drop button (Ctrl on Steam version) causes them to stop moving.

trinkets.name: Found Soul
trinkets.description: Gives you a familiar that follows Isaac's exact movements (similar to how Jacob & Esau work) and shoots spectral tears. Similar to Jacob and Esau, positions can be altered by running it into objects, or holding the drop button (Ctrl on Steam version).

trinkets.name: Expansion Pack
trinkets.description: Everytime you use your active item, you have a chance to activate another random active item. Glowing Hourglass effect is blocked from this item

trinkets.name: Beth's Essence
trinkets.description: Taking damage gives you a chance to spawn a flame orbital, similar to the ones created by Book of Virtues. Entering an Angel Room gives you +5 flame orbitals. The angel room spawned by The Stairway item also counts.

trinkets.name: The Twins
trinkets.description: Upon entering each new room, this trinket has a chance to copy one of your current familiars. If you have no familiars instead it will spawn either Brother Bobby or Sister Maggy. Only lasts for the current room

trinkets.name: Adoption Papers
trinkets.description: All shops only sell familiars while holding this trinket. If you enter a shop while holding this trinket, the effect won't undo by dropping it until you move to a new floor

trinkets.name: Cricket Leg
trinkets.description: Every time an enemy dies you have a chance to gain a random Locust. Different color Locusts correspond to the horsemen. Each of them deal double your tear damage, similar to how standard blue flies work. War (Red) - Explodes when touching the enemy.

trinkets.name: Apollyon's Best Friend
trinkets.description: Gives you a red attack fly, that will charge at enemies in the same direction you are shooting. Deals damage equal to your current tear damage. Stops charging once it hits an enemy and returns to Isaac's side

trinkets.name: Broken Glasses
trinkets.description: Gives a 33% chance to spawn an extra blind pedestal item in all future item rooms. This one will be a hidden question mark. Allows you to see what both items are on alternative path floors (Downpour/Dross, Mines/Ashpit, Gehenna/Mausoleum)

trinkets.name: Ice Cube
trinkets.description: Gives a small chance when entering a room for enemies to be petrified for 4 seconds. Killing a petrified enemy will freeze it.. The chance for this effect to activate depends on your Luck stat..

trinkets.name: Sigil of Baphomet
trinkets.description: Every time you kill an enemy you get an invincibility shield for 1 second. While shielded, each enemy killed adds +1 seconds to the duration
